title: CREMD: Crowd-Sourced Emotional Multimodal Dogs Dataset
summary: Dog emotion recognition plays a crucial role in enhancing human-animal interactions, veterinary care, and the development of automated systems for monitoring canine well-being. However, accurately interpreting dog emotions is challenging due to the subjective nature of emotional assessments and the absence of standardized ground truth methods. We present the CREMD (Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Dogs Dataset), a comprehensive dataset exploring how different presentation modes (e.g., context, audio, video) and annotator characteristics (e.g., dog ownership, gender, professional experience) influence the perception and labeling of dog emotions. The dataset consists of 923 video clips presented in three distinct modes: without context or audio, with context but no audio, and with both context and audio. We analyze annotations from diverse participants, including dog owners, professionals, and individuals with varying demographic backgrounds and experience levels, to identify factors that influence reliable dog emotion recognition. Our findings reveal several key insights: (1) while adding visual context significantly improved annotation agreement, our findings regarding audio cues are inconclusive due to design limitations (specifically, the absence of a no-context-with-audio condition and limited clean audio availability); (2) contrary to expectations, non-owners and male annotators showed higher agreement levels than dog owners and female annotators, respectively, while professionals showed higher agreement levels, aligned with our initial hypothesis; and (3) the presence of audio substantially increased annotators' confidence in identifying specific emotions, particularly anger and fear.

AI.title_translation: CREMD：众包情感多模态狗狗数据集
AI.tldr: CREMD数据集用于研究不同呈现模式（如上下文、音频、视频）和注释者特征（如养狗经验、性别、专业经验）如何影响狗情感的感知和标注，以促进可靠的狗情感识别。
AI.motivation: 狗情感识别对增强人-动物互动、兽医护理和监控犬类福祉的自动化系统开发至关重要，但准确解释狗情感具有挑战性，源于情感评估的主观性和标准化地面真实方法的缺乏。
AI.method: 介绍CREMD（众包情感多模态狗狗数据集），包含923个视频片段，以三种不同模式呈现：无上下文或音频、有上下文但无音频、以及有上下文和音频；分析来自多样化参与者（包括狗主人、专业人士和具有不同人口统计背景及经验水平的个体）的注释，以识别影响可靠狗情感识别的因素。
AI.result: 关键发现包括：（1）添加视觉上下文显著提高了注释一致性，但音频线索的结果因设计限制（具体为缺乏无上下文有音频条件且干净音频可用性有限）而不明确；（2）与预期相反，非狗主人和男性注释者比狗主人和女性注释者分别表现出更高的一致性，而专业人士的一致性更高，与初始假设一致；（3）音频的存在显著提高了注释者识别特定情感（尤其是愤怒和恐惧）的信心。
AI.conclusion: CREMD数据集揭示了不同呈现模式和注释者特征对狗情感识别的影响，为未来研究提供了基础，并强调了改进数据收集设计（如纳入无上下文有音频条件）以更准确评估音频线索的必要性。
AI.translation: 基于标题和摘要的翻译已整合到各字段中，此处不重复提供独立翻译。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了CREMD数据集，旨在探索多模态呈现和注释者多样性如何影响狗情感识别。通过分析923个视频片段在三种模式下的众包注释，发现视觉上下文提升一致性，音频增强情感识别信心，而注释者特征（如专业经验）影响标注可靠性，为狗情感识别系统的发展提供了实证见解。
AI.keywords: 狗情感识别, 多模态数据集, 众包注释, 上下文影响, 音频线索, 注释者特征
AI.comments: 该研究通过CREMD数据集系统性地解决了狗情感识别中的主观性和标准化问题，强调了多模态数据和注释者多样性的重要性。然而，设计限制（如音频条件不完整）可能影响结论的全面性，建议未来研究纳入更平衡的实验条件以进一步验证发现。

title: Fine-Tuning LLMs to Generate Economical and Reliable Actions for the Power Grid
summary: Public Safety Power Shutoffs (PSPS) force rapid topology changes that can render standard operating points infeasible, requiring operators to quickly identify corrective transmission switching actions that reduce load shedding while maintaining acceptable voltage behavior. We present a verifiable, multi-stage adaptation pipeline that fine-tunes an instruction-tuned large language model (LLM) to generate \emph{open-only} corrective switching plans from compact PSPS scenario summaries under an explicit switching budget. First, supervised fine-tuning distills a DC-OPF MILP oracle into a constrained action grammar that enables reliable parsing and feasibility checks. Second, direct preference optimization refines the policy using AC-evaluated preference pairs ranked by a voltage-penalty metric, injecting voltage-awareness beyond DC imitation. Finally, best-of-$N$ selection provides an inference-time addition by choosing the best feasible candidate under the target metric. On IEEE 118-bus PSPS scenarios, fine-tuning substantially improves DC objective values versus zero-shot generation, reduces AC power-flow failure from 50\% to single digits, and improves voltage-penalty outcomes on the common-success set. Code and data-generation scripts are released to support reproducibility.

AI.title_translation: 微调大语言模型以为电网生成经济且可靠的控制动作
AI.tldr: 作者提出一条可验证的多阶段微调管线，让指令微调后的大语言模型在给定开关预算下，从精简的PSPS场景描述中生成仅“开断线路”的纠正性切换方案，在减少负荷损失的同时显著降低交流潮流失效率并改善电压指标。
AI.motivation: 公共安全停电（PSPS）会迫使电网拓扑在短时间内剧烈变化，使既有运行点变得不可行，调度员必须快速找到既经济又满足电压约束的纠正性线路切换方案；传统优化求解和人工操作在这种高时效场景下难以及时给出高质量决策，因此需要一种既高效又可验证的新方法来自动生成可靠的操作方案。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个分三步的LLM微调与推理框架：1）监督微调：利用基于直流最优潮流（DC-OPF）的MILP“oracle”生成的最优切换方案，对指令微调后的LLM进行监督学习，并约束输出遵循特定“动作文法”，以保证方案易于解析和可行性检查，仅允许开断（open-only）且满足给定开关预算；2）直接偏好优化（DPO）：构造基于交流潮流评估的方案对，并按照电压惩罚指标排序，用DPO进一步优化策略，将交流电压意识注入模型，超越单纯模仿DC解；3）推理阶段best-of-N选择：在推理时生成多个候选方案，通过可行性检查和目标指标评估，从中选取在目标指标下最优的可行方案。
AI.result: 在IEEE 118节点的PSPS场景实验中，微调后的LLM相比零样本生成显著提升了基于DC目标的经济性，对交流潮流的计算失败率从约50%降至个位数，并且在所有成功通过交流潮流计算的方案集合上，其电压惩罚指标也得到改进；作者同时公开了代码和数据生成脚本以支持复现。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段、可验证的微调与推理策略能够让LLM在电网PSPS场景下生成兼顾经济性与电压安全的纠正性开断切换计划，并在标准测试系统上显著优于零样本基线，表明LLM在结合优化和物理评估后有望成为电网辅助决策的实用工具。
AI.translation: 公共安全停电（PSPS）会迫使电网拓扑快速变化，使得标准运行点不再可行，从而要求调度员迅速识别纠正性的输电切换动作，以在保持可接受电压行为的同时减少负荷切除。我们提出了一条可验证的、多阶段适配管线，对一个已指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）进行再微调，使其能够在显式的开关预算约束下，从紧凑的PSPS场景摘要中生成仅“开断”（open-only）的纠正性切换方案。首先，通过监督微调，将一个基于直流最优潮流（DC-OPF）的MILP“oracle”蒸馏为一套受约束的动作文法，从而实现可靠的解析与可行性检查。其次，利用基于交流（AC）评估并按电压惩罚指标排序的偏好对进行直接偏好优化，对策略进一步精炼，将电压感知能力注入到超越直流模仿的层面。最后，在推理阶段通过best-of-N选择，生成多个候选方案，并在目标指标下选出最佳可行方案，作为额外的推理时增强手段。在IEEE 118节点的PSPS场景中，相较于零样本生成，该微调过程显著改善了基于直流目标的优化值，将交流潮流失败率从50%降至个位数，并在共同成功的样本集合上改善了电压惩罚表现。我们公开了代码和数据生成脚本，以支持结果的可复现性。
AI.summary: 本文针对PSPS导致的电网拓扑突变和运行点失效问题，提出利用大语言模型自动生成纠正性输电开关方案。方法上，先用DC-OPF MILP“oracle”进行监督蒸馏，限定输出动作语法以确保只进行开断操作并满足开关预算；再用基于交流潮流和电压惩罚的偏好对进行直接偏好优化，使模型学会偏好电压表现更好的方案；最后在推理时通过best-of-N候选生成与筛选提升最终方案质量。实验在IEEE 118节点PSPS场景表明，该方法大幅提升经济性目标，交流潮流失败率从约半数降低至个位数，并在成功样本上显著改善电压指标，且提供完整代码与数据生成流程以利复现。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 电力系统, 公共安全停电(PSPS), 纠正性输电切换, 线路开断(open-only)操作, 最优潮流(DC-OPF), MILP oracle, 监督微调, 直接偏好优化(DPO), best-of-N选择, 交流潮流评估, 电压惩罚指标, IEEE 118节点测试系统, 可验证决策生成, 负荷切除减少
AI.comments: 工作巧妙结合优化“oracle”、偏好学习与可行性检查，使LLM生成的控制动作具备可验证性和物理约束意识，是LLM与电力系统运维结合的一个有代表性的范例。但目前仅在IEEE 118节点仿真场景验证，尚未体现对更大规模系统、真实在线数据和运行时约束（如计算时限、通信延迟、操作安全规程等）的适应性；此外方法高度依赖高质量的DC-OPF解与AC评估，实际部署还需考虑模型更新、极端工况泛化以及与调度员交互方式等问题。

title: Feasibility-aware Imitation Learning from Observation with Multimodal Feedback
summary: Imitation learning frameworks that learn robot control policies from demonstrators' motions via hand-mounted demonstration interfaces have attracted increasing attention. However, due to differences in physical characteristics between demonstrators and robots, this approach faces two limitations: i) the demonstration data do not include robot actions, and ii) the demonstrated motions may be infeasible for robots. These limitations make policy learning difficult. To address them, we propose Feasibility-Aware Behavior Cloning from Observation (FABCO). FABCO integrates behavior cloning from observation, which complements robot actions using robot dynamics models, with feasibility estimation. In feasibility estimation, the demonstrated motions are evaluated using a robot-dynamics model, learned from the robot's execution data, to assess reproducibility under the robot's dynamics. The estimated feasibility is used for multimodal feedback and feasibility-aware policy learning to improve the demonstrator's motions and learn robust policies. Multimodal feedback provides feasibility through the demonstrator's visual and haptic senses to promote feasible demonstrated motions. Feasibility-aware policy learning reduces the influence of demonstrated motions that are infeasible for robots, enabling the learning of policies that robots can execute stably. We conducted experiments with 15 participants on two tasks and confirmed that FABCO improves imitation learning performance by more than 3.2 times compared to the case without feasibility feedback.

AI.title_translation: 具有多模态反馈的可行性感知观察模仿学习
AI.tldr: 提出FABCO框架，通过可行性估计、多模态反馈与可行性感知策略学习，使机器人在仅观测人类动作且存在动力学差异的情况下，仍能学得可执行且性能提升超过3.2倍的控制策略。
AI.motivation: 现有通过手持示教装置获取人类动作的模仿学习方法存在两大问题：示教数据不包含机器人动作信息，以及人类示教轨迹在机器人动力学下可能不可行，导致策略学习困难，因此需要一种同时补全机器人动作并考虑可行性的模仿学习框架。
AI.method: 提出FABCO（Feasibility-Aware Behavior Cloning from Observation）：首先基于机器人动力学模型，将仅有人类动作的观测转换为包含机器人可执行动作的行为克隆数据；其次利用由机器人执行数据学习得到的机器人动力学模型，对示教动作进行可行性估计；然后通过多模态反馈（视觉与触觉）向示教者实时呈现可行性，促使其提供更可行的示教；最后在策略学习阶段根据可行性权重削弱不可行示教的影响，从而得到鲁棒且稳定可执行的策略。
AI.result: 在包含15名被试、两个任务的实验中，FABCO相较于不使用可行性反馈的情况，使模仿学习性能提升超过3.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 将可行性估计融入从观测中进行的行为克隆，并结合多模态反馈与可行性感知策略学习，能够有效纠正或弱化对机器人而言不可行的人类示教动作，从而显著提升机器人模仿学习的可执行性与性能。
AI.translation: 通过手持式示教接口，从示教者动作中学习机器人控制策略的模仿学习框架正受到越来越多的关注。然而，由于示教者与机器人在物理特性上的差异，这种方法面临两个局限：i）示教数据不包含机器人动作；ii）示教的动作轨迹对于机器人而言可能不可行。这些局限使得策略学习变得困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了可行性感知的从观测中进行行为克隆方法（FABCO）。FABCO将从观测中进行的行为克隆（利用机器人动力学模型补全机器人动作）与可行性估计相结合。在可行性估计中，使用根据机器人执行数据学习得到的机器人动力学模型，对示教动作进行评估，以判断其在机器人动力学下的可复现性。估计得到的可行性用于多模态反馈和可行性感知的策略学习，以改进示教者的动作并学习鲁棒的策略。多模态反馈通过示教者的视觉和触觉感知向其提供可行性信息，促使其产生更可行的示教动作。可行性感知的策略学习则降低对机器人不可行示教动作的影响，使机器人能够学习到稳定可执行的策略。我们在两个任务上对15名参与者进行了实验，验证了FABCO相较于没有可行性反馈的情况，可将模仿学习性能提升3.2倍以上。
AI.summary: 本文针对人类示教与机器人动力学不匹配的问题，提出FABCO框架。该方法首先利用机器人动力学模型，将仅有示教者动作的观测补全为机器人可执行的动作数据；其次学习一个基于机器人执行数据的动力学模型，对每条示教轨迹进行可行性评估。系统再将可行性通过视觉和触觉同时反馈给示教者，引导其生成更适合机器人的示教动作；在策略训练时，又根据可行性对样本加权，减弱不可行示教的负面影响。实验结果表明，在两个任务和15名参与者的场景下，引入可行性估计与多模态反馈后，模仿学习性能比不使用可行性反馈时提升了3.2倍以上，说明该方法能显著提高机器人从人类示教中学得的策略质量与可执行性。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, 从观测中学习, 行为克隆, 机器人动力学, 可行性估计, 多模态反馈, 视觉反馈, 触觉反馈, 策略学习, 机器人控制
AI.comments: 方法创新地将可行性估计与多模态人机交互结合，用于过滤和纠正不可行示教，思想清晰且贴近实际机器人限制；但摘要未说明具体任务类型、性能指标定义、与其他先进模仿学习方法的对比情况，也未提及在复杂高维任务或动态环境中的适用性。

title: NeuroSymActive: Differentiable Neural-Symbolic Reasoning with Active Exploration for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Large pretrained language models and neural reasoning systems have advanced many natural language tasks, yet they remain challenged by knowledge-intensive queries that require precise, structured multi-hop inference. Knowledge graphs provide a compact symbolic substrate for factual grounding, but integrating graph structure with neural models is nontrivial: naively embedding graph facts into prompts leads to inefficiency and fragility, while purely symbolic or search-heavy approaches can be costly in retrievals and lack gradient-based refinement. We introduce NeuroSymActive, a modular framework that combines a differentiable neural-symbolic reasoning layer with an active, value-guided exploration controller for Knowledge Graph Question Answering. The method couples soft-unification style symbolic modules with a neural path evaluator and a Monte-Carlo style exploration policy that prioritizes high-value path expansions. Empirical results on standard KGQA benchmarks show that NeuroSymActive attains strong answer accuracy while reducing the number of expensive graph lookups and model calls compared to common retrieval-augmented baselines.

AI.title_translation: NeuroSymActive：用于知识图谱问答的可微神经-符号推理与主动探索框架
AI.tldr: 提出NeuroSymActive框架，将可微神经-符号推理与主动价值引导探索结合，在知识图谱问答上以更少检索成本获得较高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型和神经推理系统在需要精确、结构化多跳推理的知识密集型问题上表现不足；直接把知识图谱事实塞进提示既低效又脆弱，而纯符号或重搜索方法检索代价高且难以通过梯度优化，因此需要一种既能利用知识图谱结构又可端到端优化、且检索开销更低的KGQA方法。
AI.method: 提出NeuroSymActive模块化框架，在可微神经-符号推理层中使用软统一风格的符号模块与神经路径评估器联合建模，再通过类似蒙特卡洛的主动探索策略，对知识图谱上的推理路径进行价值引导的扩展，以优先探索高价值路径，从而同时实现可微优化与高效检索。
AI.result: 在标准知识图谱问答基准上，NeuroSymActive在答案准确率方面表现优异，同时相比常见的检索增强基线显著减少昂贵的图查询次数和模型调用次数（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: NeuroSymActive证明了将可微神经-符号推理与主动价值引导探索结合，可以在知识图谱问答中兼顾高准确率与低检索/计算成本，为高效的结构化多跳推理提供了一条可行路径。
AI.translation: 大型预训练语言模型和神经推理系统推动了许多自然语言任务的发展，但在需要精确、结构化多跳推理的知识密集型查询上仍然面临挑战。知识图谱为事实支撑提供了紧凑的符号基础，但将图结构与神经模型集成并不简单：将图事实直接嵌入提示会导致低效且脆弱，而纯符号或重搜索的方法在检索上代价高昂，且缺乏基于梯度的细化能力。我们提出NeuroSymActive，这是一个面向知识图谱问答的模块化框架，将可微神经-符号推理层与主动的、基于价值引导的探索控制器相结合。该方法将软统一风格的符号模块与神经路径评估器耦合，并采用类似蒙特卡洛的探索策略，优先扩展高价值的推理路径。在标准KGQA基准数据集上的实验证明，NeuroSymActive在答案准确率上表现优良，并且相比常见的检索增强基线方法，减少了昂贵的图查找和模型调用次数。
AI.summary: 本文针对知识图谱问答中的多跳结构化推理难题，提出NeuroSymActive，将软统一式符号模块、神经路径评估器与蒙特卡洛风格的价值引导探索策略结合，实现端到端可微的神经-符号推理，同时主动选择高价值路径扩展，从而在保持或提升答案准确率的同时显著降低知识图谱检索和模型调用开销。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱问答, 神经-符号推理, 可微推理, 主动探索, 路径推理, 检索增强, 多跳推理
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于把可微神经-符号层与基于价值的探索策略统一本到一个KGQA框架中，兼顾可训练性与推理效率；但摘要未给出具体指标或与哪些基线对比，细节和泛化性有待阅读正文评估。

title: A Comparison of Bayesian Prediction Techniques for Mobile Robot Trajectory Tracking
comments: Accepted in Robotica (Dec. 2007), vol. 26, n. 5, pp. 571-585 (c) 2008 Cambridge University Press. https://doi.org/10.1017/S0263574708004153
summary: This paper presents a performance comparison of different estimation and prediction techniques applied to the problem of tracking multiple robots. The main performance criteria are the magnitude of the estimation or prediction error, the computational effort and the robustness of each method to non-Gaussian noise. Among the different techniques compared are the well known Kalman filters and their different variants (e.g. extended and unscented), and the more recent techniques relying on Sequential Monte Carlo Sampling methods, such as particle filters and Gaussian Mixture Sigma Point Particle Filter.

title: DAV-GSWT: Diffusion-Active-View Sampling for Data-Efficient Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles
summary: The emergence of 3D Gaussian Splatting has fundamentally redefined the capabilities of photorealistic neural rendering by enabling high-throughput synthesis of complex environments. While procedural methods like Wang Tiles have recently been integrated to facilitate the generation of expansive landscapes, these systems typically remain constrained by a reliance on densely sampled exemplar reconstructions. We present DAV-GSWT, a data-efficient framework that leverages diffusion priors and active view sampling to synthesize high-fidelity Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles from minimal input observations. By integrating a hierarchical uncertainty quantification mechanism with generative diffusion models, our approach autonomously identifies the most informative viewpoints while hallucinating missing structural details to ensure seamless tile transitions. Experimental results indicate that our system significantly reduces the required data volume while maintaining the visual integrity and interactive performance necessary for large-scale virtual environments.

title: Co-Design and Evaluation of a CPU-Free MPI GPU Communication Abstraction and Implementation
summary: Removing the CPU from the communication fast path is essential to efficient GPU-based ML and HPC application performance. However, existing GPU communication APIs either continue to rely on the CPU for communication or rely on APIs that place significant synchronization burdens on programmers. In this paper we describe the design, implementation, and evaluation of an MPI-based GPU communication API enabling easy-to-use, high-performance, CPU-free communication. This API builds on previously proposed MPI extensions and leverages HPE Slingshot 11 network card capabilities. We demonstrate the utility and performance of the API by showing how the API naturally enables CPU-free gather/scatter halo exchange communication primitives in the Cabana/Kokkos performance portability framework, and through a performance comparison with Cray MPICH on the Frontier and Tuolumne supercomputers. Results from this evaluation show up to a 50% reduction in medium message latency in simple GPU ping-pong exchanges and a 28% speedup improvement when strong scaling a halo-exchange benchmark to 8,192 GPUs of the Frontier supercomputer.

title: Fluoroscopy-Constrained Magnetic Robot Control via Zernike-Based Field Modeling and Nonlinear MPC
summary: Magnetic actuation enables surgical robots to navigate complex anatomical pathways while reducing tissue trauma and improving surgical precision. However, clinical deployment is limited by the challenges of controlling such systems under fluoroscopic imaging, which provides low frame rate and noisy pose feedback. This paper presents a control framework that remains accurate and stable under such conditions by combining a nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework that directly outputs coil currents, an analytically differentiable magnetic field model based on Zernike polynomials, and a Kalman filter to estimate the robot state. Experimental validation is conducted with two magnetic robots in a 3D-printed fluid workspace and a spine phantom replicating drug delivery in the epidural space. Results show the proposed control method remains highly accurate when feedback is downsampled to 3 Hz with added Gaussian noise (sigma = 2 mm), mimicking clinical fluoroscopy. In the spine phantom experiments, the proposed method successfully executed a drug delivery trajectory with a root mean square (RMS) position error of 1.18 mm while maintaining safe clearance from critical anatomical boundaries.

title: Semantics-Aware Denoising: A PLM-Guided Sample Reweighting Strategy for Robust Recommendation
summary: Implicit feedback, such as user clicks, serves as the primary data source for modern recommender systems. However, click interactions inherently contain substantial noise, including accidental clicks, clickbait-induced interactions, and exploratory browsing behaviors that do not reflect genuine user preferences. Training recommendation models with such noisy positive samples leads to degraded prediction accuracy and unreliable recommendations. In this paper, we propose SAID (Semantics-Aware Implicit Denoising), a simple yet effective framework that leverages semantic consistency between user interests and item content to identify and downweight potentially noisy interactions. Our approach constructs textual user interest profiles from historical behaviors and computes semantic similarity with target item descriptions using pre-trained language model (PLM) based text encoders. The similarity scores are then transformed into sample weights that modulate the training loss, effectively reducing the impact of semantically inconsistent clicks. Unlike existing denoising methods that require complex auxiliary networks or multi-stage training procedures, SAID only modifies the loss function while keeping the backbone recommendation model unchanged. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that SAID consistently improves recommendation performance, achieving up to 2.2% relative improvement in AUC over strong baselines, with particularly notable robustness under high noise conditions.

AI.title_translation: 语义感知去噪：一种基于PLM的样本重新加权策略，用于鲁棒推荐

AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，SAID持续改进了推荐性能，相对于强基线，AUC相对提高了2.2%，在高度噪声条件下表现出特别显著的鲁棒性。

title: Crane: An Accurate and Scalable Neural Sketch for Graph Stream Summarization
summary: Graph streams are rapidly evolving sequences of edges that convey continuously changing relationships among entities, playing a crucial role in domains such as networking, finance, and cybersecurity. Their massive scale and high dynamism make obtaining accurate statistics challenging with limited memory constraints. Traditional methods summarize graph streams through hand-crafted sketches, while recent studies have begun to replace these sketches with neural counterparts to improve adaptability and accuracy. However, this shift faces a major challenge: under limited memory, dominant frequent items tend to overshadow rare ones, hindering the neural network's ability to recover accurate statistics. To address this, we propose Crane, a hierarchical neural sketch architecture for graph stream summarization. Crane uses a hierarchical carry mechanism that automatically elevates frequent items to higher memory layers, reducing interference between frequent and infrequent items within the same layer. To better accommodate real-world deployment, Crane further adopts an adaptive memory expansion strategy that dynamically adds new layers once the occupancy of the top layer exceeds a threshold, enabling scalability across diverse data magnitudes. Extensive experiments on various datasets ranging from 20K to 60M edges demonstrate that Crane reduces estimation error by roughly 10x compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: Crane：一种用于图流摘要的准确且可扩展的神经草图
AI.tldr: Crane是一个分层神经草图架构，通过分层进位机制和自适应内存扩展，显著提高了图流摘要的准确性和可扩展性，将估计误差降低了约10倍。
AI.motivation: 图流规模大、动态性高，在有限内存下难以获得准确统计数据。传统方法依赖手工草图，而现有神经草图在有限内存下，频繁项会掩盖稀有项，影响准确性。
AI.method: 本文提出了Crane，一个分层神经草图架构。它使用分层进位机制自动将频繁项提升到更高内存层，减少频繁项和不频繁项的干扰。此外，采用自适应内存扩展策略，当顶层占用率超过阈值时动态添加新层，以适应不同数据量级。
AI.result: 在2万到6千万边的各种数据集上，Crane将估计误差比现有最新方法降低了约10倍。
AI.conclusion: Crane通过其独特的分层架构和内存管理策略，有效解决了图流摘要中准确性和可扩展性的挑战，实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 图流是快速演变的边序列，传达实体之间不断变化的关系，在网络、金融和网络安全等领域发挥着关键作用。其大规模和高动态性使得在有限内存约束下获取准确统计数据具有挑战性。传统方法通过手工设计的草图来汇总图流，而最近的研究已开始用神经对应物取代这些草图，以提高适应性和准确性。然而，这种转变面临一个主要挑战：在有限内存下，占主导地位的频繁项往往会掩盖稀有项，阻碍神经网络恢复准确统计数据的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Crane，一个用于图流摘要的分层神经草图架构。Crane使用分层进位机制，自动将频繁项提升到更高的内存层，减少同一层中频繁项和不频繁项之间的干扰。为了更好地适应实际部署，Crane进一步采用了自适应内存扩展策略，一旦顶层的占用率超过阈值，就会动态添加新层，从而实现跨不同数据量级的可扩展性。对从2万到6千万边不等的各种数据集进行的广泛实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，Crane将估计误差降低了大约10倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Crane，一种用于图流摘要的分层神经草图架构，旨在解决现有方法在有限内存下处理大规模动态图流时，频繁项掩盖稀有项导致准确性下降的问题。Crane通过分层进位机制将频繁项提升到高层内存，并采用自适应内存扩展策略动态调整层数，从而减少项间干扰并提高可扩展性。实验证明，Crane将估计误差比现有最新方法降低了约10倍，显著提高了图流统计的准确性和效率。
AI.keywords: 图流摘要, 神经草图, 分层架构, 内存管理, 可扩展性
AI.comments: Crane的创新点在于其分层神经草图架构，特别是分层进位机制和自适应内存扩展策略。这有效地解决了在资源受限环境下，图流摘要中频繁项对稀有项的干扰以及数据规模变化带来的可扩展性问题。该方法在准确性上取得了显著提升，对大规模动态图数据分析具有重要意义。

title: Automated Multi-Source Debugging and Natural Language Error Explanation for Dashboard Applications
comments: Accepted for publication at the 12th (Springer CCIS) International Conference on Information Management, March 27-29, 2026, Oxford, UK
summary: Modern web dashboards and enterprise applications increasingly rely on complex, distributed microservices architectures. While these architectures offer scalability, they introduce significant challenges in debugging and observability. When failures occur, they often manifest as opaque error messages to the end-user such as Something went wrong. This masks the underlying root cause which may reside in browser side exceptions, API contract violations, or server side logic failures. Existing monitoring tools capture these events in isolation but fail to correlate them effectively or provide intelligible explanations to non technical users. This paper proposes a novel system for Automated Multi Source Debugging and Natural Language Error Explanation. The proposed framework automatically collects and correlates error data from disparate sources such as browser, API, server logs and validates API contracts in real time, and utilizes Large Language Models to generate natural language explanations. This approach significantly reduces Mean Time to Resolution for support engineers and improves the user experience by transforming cryptic error codes into actionable insights.

AI.title_translation: 仪表盘应用的自动化多源调试与自然语言错误解释
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对现代分布式微服务应用的自动化多源调试与自然语言错误解释系统，该系统通过关联来自浏览器、API和服务器日志的错误数据，并利用大型语言模型生成易于理解的错误解释，从而显著减少故障解决时间并改善用户体验。
AI.motivation: 现代网络仪表盘和企业应用依赖复杂的分布式微服务架构，这在调试和可观察性方面带来了巨大挑战。故障常以模糊的错误消息呈现给最终用户，掩盖了浏览器、API或服务器端的根本原因。现有监控工具无法有效关联这些孤立的事件或向非技术用户提供可理解的解释。
AI.method: 所提出的系统通过自动收集并关联来自浏览器、API、服务器日志等不同来源的错误数据，实时验证API契约，并利用大型语言模型生成自然语言解释。
AI.result: 该方法显著缩短了支持工程师的平均解决时间（MTTR），并通过将神秘的错误代码转化为可操作的见解，改善了用户体验。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过关联多源错误数据并提供清晰的自然语言解释，有效解决了复杂分布式应用调试的挑战，从而实现更快的故障解决时间和更好的用户体验。
AI.translation: 现代网络仪表盘和企业应用日益依赖复杂的分布式微服务架构。虽然这些架构提供了可扩展性，但它们在调试和可观察性方面带来了巨大的挑战。当故障发生时，它们通常以“Something went wrong”之类的模糊错误消息呈现给最终用户。这掩盖了可能存在于浏览器端异常、API契约违规或服务器端逻辑故障的底层根本原因。现有监控工具单独捕获这些事件，但未能有效地关联它们或向非技术用户提供可理解的解释。本文提出了一种用于自动化多源调试和自然语言错误解释的新颖系统。所提出的框架自动收集并关联来自不同来源（如浏览器、API、服务器日志）的错误数据，实时验证API契约，并利用大型语言模型生成自然语言解释。这种方法显著缩短了支持工程师的平均解决时间，并通过将神秘的错误代码转化为可操作的见解来改善用户体验。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对分布式微服务架构的自动化多源调试和自然语言错误解释系统。该系统通过自动收集、关联来自浏览器、API和服务器日志等不同来源的错误数据，并实时验证API契约，结合大型语言模型生成易于理解的自然语言错误解释，从而显著缩短支持工程师的故障解决时间，并提升最终用户体验。
AI.keywords: 自动化调试, 多源, 自然语言解释, 微服务, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 这项工作通过集成多源数据关联和大型语言模型，为复杂的分布式应用调试提供了一个创新解决方案，尤其在将技术错误转化为非技术用户可理解的解释方面具有重要意义，有助于提高运维效率和用户满意度。

title: MarkSweep: A No-box Removal Attack on AI-Generated Image Watermarking via Noise Intensification and Frequency-aware Denoising
comments: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of ICASSP 2026 (2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing)
summary: AI watermarking embeds invisible signals within images to provide provenance information and identify content as AI-generated. In this paper, we introduce MarkSweep, a novel watermark removal attack that effectively erases the embedded watermarks from AI-generated images without degrading visual quality. MarkSweep first amplifies watermark noise in high-frequency regions via edge-aware Gaussian perturbations and injects it into clean images for training a denoising network. This network then integrates two modules, the learnable frequency decomposition module and the frequency-aware fusion module, to suppress amplified noise and eliminate watermark traces. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments demonstrate that invisible watermarks are highly vulnerable to MarkSweep, which effectively removes embedded watermarks, reducing the bit accuracy of HiDDeN and Stable Signature watermarking schemes to below 67%, while preserving perceptual quality of AI-generated images.

AI.title_translation: MarkSweep：一种通过噪声增强和频率感知去噪针对AI生成图像水印的无盒移除攻击
AI.tldr: MarkSweep是一种新的水印移除攻击，它通过噪声增强和频率感知去噪，能够有效擦除AI生成图像中的隐形水印，同时保持图像质量，并显著降低现有水印方案的准确性。
AI.motivation: AI水印技术旨在通过嵌入隐形信号来提供图像来源信息并识别AI生成内容。本研究的动机是开发一种攻击方法来有效移除这些嵌入的水印，以证明其脆弱性。
AI.method: MarkSweep首先通过边缘感知高斯扰动在高频区域放大水印噪声，并将其注入到干净图像中以训练一个去噪网络。该网络集成了可学习的频率分解模块和频率感知融合模块，以抑制放大的噪声并消除水印痕迹。
AI.result: 实验证明，隐形水印极易受到MarkSweep的攻击，该方法能有效移除嵌入的水印，将HiDDeN和Stable Signature水印方案的比特准确率降低到67%以下，同时保持AI生成图像的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: MarkSweep攻击表明，现有的隐形AI图像水印方案存在显著的脆弱性，可以被有效移除而不会损害图像的视觉质量。
AI.translation: AI水印技术在图像中嵌入不可见的信号，以提供来源信息并识别AI生成内容。在本文中，我们引入了MarkSweep，一种新颖的水印移除攻击，它能够有效地从AI生成图像中擦除嵌入的水印，而不会降低视觉质量。MarkSweep首先通过边缘感知高斯扰动在高频区域放大水印噪声，并将其注入到干净图像中以训练一个去噪网络。该网络随后集成了两个模块：可学习的频率分解模块和频率感知融合模块，以抑制放大的噪声并消除水印痕迹。理论分析和广泛的实验表明，隐形水印极易受到MarkSweep的攻击，它能有效移除嵌入的水印，将HiDDeN和Stable Signature水印方案的比特准确率降低到67%以下，同时保持AI生成图像的感知质量。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了MarkSweep，一种针对AI生成图像水印的无盒移除攻击。该方法通过在高频区域放大水印噪声并训练一个集成了频率分解和融合模块的去噪网络来工作，从而有效擦除图像中的隐形水印。实验结果表明，MarkSweep能够显著降低现有水印方案（如HiDDeN和Stable Signature）的准确性至67%以下，同时保持图像的视觉质量，揭示了AI图像水印的脆弱性。
AI.keywords: AI水印, 水印移除, 无盒攻击, 噪声增强, 频率感知去噪
AI.comments: MarkSweep提出了一种新颖且有效的无盒水印移除攻击，其创新之处在于结合了噪声增强和频率感知去噪技术。这项研究的重要性在于揭示了当前AI图像水印技术的脆弱性，可能促使未来水印技术在鲁棒性方面进行改进。然而，这也可能为恶意篡改AI生成内容提供了工具。

title: CDRL: A Reinforcement Learning Framework Inspired by Cerebellar Circuits and Dendritic Computational Strategies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved notable performance in high-dimensional sequential decision-making tasks, yet remains limited by low sample efficiency, sensitivity to noise, and weak generalization under partial observability. Most existing approaches address these issues primarily through optimization strategies, while the role of architectural priors in shaping representation learning and decision dynamics is less explored. Inspired by structural principles of the cerebellum, we propose a biologically grounded RL architecture that incorporate large expansion, sparse connectivity, sparse activation, and dendritic-level modulation. Experiments on noisy, high-dimensional RL benchmarks show that both the cerebellar architecture and dendritic modulation consistently improve sample efficiency, robustness, and generalization compared to conventional designs. Sensitivity analysis of architectural parameters suggests that cerebellum-inspired structures can offer optimized performance for RL with constrained model parameters. Overall, our work underscores the value of cerebellar structural priors as effective inductive biases for RL.

AI.title_translation: CDRL：一种受小脑回路和树突计算策略启发的强化学习框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受小脑结构启发的强化学习（CDRL）框架，通过引入大扩展、稀疏连接、稀疏激活和树突级调制，显著提高了强化学习在样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习在处理高维序贯决策任务时面临样本效率低、对噪声敏感以及在部分可观测性下泛化能力弱等问题。现有方法主要侧重于优化策略，而对架构先验在塑造表征学习和决策动力学中的作用探索不足。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种受小脑结构原则启发的生物学基础强化学习架构。该架构整合了大扩展、稀疏连接、稀疏激活和树突级调制等特性。
AI.result: 在有噪声、高维的强化学习基准测试中，小脑架构和树突调制相比传统设计，一致性地提高了样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力。对架构参数的敏感性分析表明，受小脑启发的结构可以在模型参数受限的情况下提供优化的强化学习性能。
AI.conclusion: 我们的工作强调了小脑结构先验作为强化学习有效归纳偏置的价值。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）在高维序贯决策任务中取得了显著成就，但仍受限于样本效率低、对噪声敏感以及在部分可观测性下泛化能力弱等问题。大多数现有方法主要通过优化策略来解决这些问题，而架构先验在塑造表征学习和决策动力学中的作用则较少被探索。受小脑结构原理的启发，我们提出了一种具有生物学基础的强化学习架构，该架构融合了大规模扩展、稀疏连接、稀疏激活和树突级调制。在有噪声、高维强化学习基准测试中的实验表明，与传统设计相比，小脑架构和树突调制一致性地提高了样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力。对架构参数的敏感性分析表明，受小脑启发的结构可以为具有受限模型参数的强化学习提供优化的性能。总的来说，我们的工作强调了小脑结构先验作为强化学习有效归纳偏置的价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CDRL的强化学习框架，其灵感来源于小脑回路和树突计算策略，旨在解决现有强化学习方法在样本效率、噪声鲁棒性和泛化能力方面的局限性。该框架引入了受小脑启发的结构原则，包括大规模扩展、稀疏连接、稀疏激活和树突级调制。实验结果表明，CDRL在有噪声、高维的强化学习任务中显著提升了样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力，并指出小脑结构先验是强化学习的有效归纳偏置。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 小脑回路, 树突计算, 样本效率, 归纳偏置
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将生物学启发的小脑结构先验引入到强化学习架构中，而非仅仅依赖优化策略。通过模拟小脑的特定计算策略，如稀疏性和树突调制，有效解决了当前RL系统面临的样本效率低、对噪声敏感和泛化能力差的问题。这为设计更高效、更鲁棒的RL系统提供了新的视角和方向，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: GMAIL: Generative Modality Alignment for generated Image Learning
summary: Generative models have made it possible to synthesize highly realistic images, potentially providing an abundant data source for training machine learning models. Despite the advantages of these synthesizable data sources, the indiscriminate use of generated images as real images for training can even cause mode collapse due to modality discrepancies between real and synthetic domains. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for discriminative use of generated images, coined GMAIL, that explicitly treats generated images as a separate modality from real images. Instead of indiscriminately replacing real images with generated ones in the pixel space, our approach bridges the two distinct modalities in the same latent space through a multi-modal learning approach. To be specific, we first fine-tune a model exclusively on generated images using a cross-modality alignment loss and then employ this aligned model to further train various vision-language models with generated images. By aligning the two modalities, our approach effectively leverages the benefits of recent advances in generative models, thereby boosting the effectiveness of generated image learning across a range of vision-language tasks. Our framework can be easily incorporated with various vision-language models, and we demonstrate its efficacy throughout extensive experiments. For example, our framework significantly improves performance on image captioning, zero-shot image retrieval, zero-shot image classification, and long caption retrieval tasks. It also shows positive generated data scaling trends and notable enhancements in the captioning performance of the large multimodal model, LLaVA.

AI.title_translation: GMAIL：生成模态对齐用于生成图像学习
AI.tldr: GMAIL提出一种新颖框架，通过在潜在空间对齐真实图像和生成图像的模态，有效利用生成图像训练视觉语言模型，避免模式崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将生成的图像不加区分地用于训练，可能因真实和合成域之间的模态差异导致模式崩溃。因此，需要一种判别性地利用生成图像的方法。
AI.method: 提出GMAIL框架，将生成图像视为独立于真实图像的模态。通过多模态学习方法，在相同的潜在空间中桥接两种不同的模态。具体来说，首先使用跨模态对齐损失在生成图像上微调模型，然后用这个对齐的模型进一步训练各种视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 显著提高了图像字幕、零样本图像检索、零样本图像分类和长字幕检索任务的性能。显示出积极的生成数据扩展趋势，并显著增强了大型多模态模型LLaVA的字幕性能。
AI.conclusion: GMAIL框架通过对齐真实图像和生成图像的模态，有效利用了生成模型的最新进展，从而提高了生成图像学习在一系列视觉语言任务中的有效性，并且可以轻松地与各种视觉语言模型结合。
AI.translation: 生成模型使得合成高度逼真的图像成为可能，这可能为训练机器学习模型提供丰富的数据源。尽管这些可合成数据源具有优势，但将生成的图像不加区分地用作真实图像进行训练，甚至可能由于真实和合成域之间的模态差异而导致模式崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了一种判别性使用生成图像的新颖框架，命名为GMAIL，它明确地将生成图像视为独立于真实图像的模态。我们的方法不是在像素空间中不加区分地用生成图像替换真实图像，而是通过多模态学习方法在相同的潜在空间中桥接这两个不同的模态。具体来说，我们首先使用跨模态对齐损失仅在生成图像上微调模型，然后利用这个对齐的模型进一步训练各种视觉语言模型。通过对齐这两种模态，我们的方法有效利用了生成模型最新进展的优势，从而提高了生成图像学习在一系列视觉语言任务中的有效性。我们的框架可以很容易地与各种视觉语言模型结合，并且我们在广泛的实验中证明了其有效性。例如，我们的框架显著提高了图像字幕、零样本图像检索、零样本图像分类和长字幕检索任务的性能。它还显示出积极的生成数据扩展趋势，并显著增强了大型多模态模型LLaVA的字幕性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GMAIL框架，旨在解决将生成图像不加区分地用于模型训练导致的模态差异和模式崩溃问题。GMAIL将生成图像视为独立模态，并通过多模态学习在潜在空间中对齐真实图像和生成图像。该方法首先在生成图像上进行模型微调，然后用于训练视觉语言模型，从而有效利用生成数据，提升了图像字幕、零样本检索分类等多种视觉语言任务的性能，并展现了良好的数据扩展性。
AI.keywords: 生成图像学习, 模态对齐, 视觉语言模型, 多模态学习, GMAIL
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法来解决生成图像在机器学习训练中遇到的模态不匹配问题。通过将生成图像视为独立模态并在潜在空间进行对齐，GMAIL框架有效利用了生成模型的优势，避免了模式崩溃，并提高了视觉语言任务的性能。其通用性强，可与多种视觉语言模型结合，具有重要的实践意义。

title: From PhysioNet to Foundation Models -- A history and potential futures
comments: 56 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Extended from: Gari D. Clifford. Past, Present and Future Challenges in Sharing Science: From PhysioNet to Foundation Models. 51st Computing in Cardiology, Karlsruhe, Germany, 51:1-4, 2024
summary: Over the last 35 years, the sharing of medical data and models for research has evolved from sneakernet to the internet - from mailing magnetic tapes and compact discs of a handful of well-curated recordings, to the high-speed download of relatively comprehensive hospital databases. More recently, the fervor around the potential for modern machine learning and 'AI' to catapult us into the next industrial revolution has led to a seemingly insatiable desire to pump almost any source of data into large models. Although this has great potential, it also presents a whole set of new challenges. In this article I examine these trends over the last 30 years, drawing on examples from cardiology, one of the oldest data-intensive fields that is undergoing a renaissance via machine learning. From the early days of computerized cardiology, the Research Resource for Complex Physiologic Signals (PhysioNet) has been at the cutting edge of this field. This article, therefore, includes much of the Resource's history and the contributions drawn from 25 years of firsthand experience of co-developing elements of the Resource with its founders. I identify the most promising future directions for the PhysioNet Resource, and more generally, the growing issues and opportunities around dissemination and use of massive physiological databases, associated open access code, and public competitions, along with potential solutions to the key issues facing our field. Topics range from how we should approach foundation models in the context of the rapidly growing AI carbon footprint, to the potential of Tiny-ML and edge computing. I also cover issues around prizes and incentives, funding models, and scientific repeatability, as well as how we might address these issues by leveraging the PhysioNet Challenges, consistent with the philosophy of open-access from the early days of the PhysioNet Resource.

title: Far Out: Evaluating Language Models on Slang in Australian and Indian English
comments: Accepted as a paper at 13th VarDial workshop at EACL 2026
summary: Language models exhibit systematic performance gaps when processing text in non-standard language varieties, yet their ability to comprehend variety-specific slang remains underexplored for several languages. We present a comprehensive evaluation of slang awareness in Indian English (en-IN) and Australian English (en-AU) across seven state-of-the-art language models. We construct two complementary datasets: \textsc{web}, containing 377 web-sourced usage examples from Urban Dictionary, and \textsc{gen}, featuring 1,492 synthetically generated usages of these slang terms, across diverse scenarios. We assess language models on three tasks: target word prediction (TWP), guided target word prediction (TWP$^*$) and target word selection (TWS). Our results reveal four key findings: (1) Higher average model performance TWS versus TWP and TWP$^*$, with average accuracy score increasing from 0.03 to 0.49 respectively (2) Stronger average model performance on \textsc{web} versus \textsc{gen} datasets, with average similarity score increasing by 0.03 and 0.05 across TWP and TWP$^*$ tasks respectively (3) en-IN tasks outperform en-AU when averaged across all models and datasets, with TWS demonstrating the largest disparity, increasing average accuracy from 0.44 to 0.54. These findings underscore fundamental asymmetries between generative and discriminative competencies for variety-specific language, particularly in the context of slang expressions despite being in a technologically rich language such as English.

AI.title_translation: 太远了：评估语言模型在澳大利亚和印度英语俚语方面的表现
AI.tldr: 本文评估了七种最先进的语言模型在理解印度英语和澳大利亚英语俚语方面的能力，发现模型在歧视性任务和真实网络数据上表现更好，且在印度英语上的表现优于澳大利亚英语，揭示了模型处理特定变体语言俚语时的生成和判别能力之间存在不对称性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在处理非标准语言变体文本时存在系统性性能差距，但其理解特定方言俚语的能力在多种语言中仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 研究评估了七种最先进的语言模型在印度英语（en-IN）和澳大利亚英语（en-AU）俚语方面的认知能力。构建了两个互补数据集：\textsc{web}（包含377个来自Urban Dictionary的网络源用法示例）和\textsc{gen}（包含1,492个合成生成的俚语用法）。通过目标词预测（TWP）、引导目标词预测（TWP$^*$）和目标词选择（TWS）三项任务评估语言模型。
AI.result:
1. TWS任务的平均模型性能高于TWP和TWP$^*$，平均准确率从0.03提高到0.49。
2. \textsc{web}数据集上的平均模型性能强于\textsc{gen}数据集，在TWP和TWP$^*$任务中，平均相似度得分分别提高了0.03和0.05。
3. 在所有模型和数据集上取平均值时，en-IN任务的表现优于en-AU，其中TWS任务的差异最大，平均准确率从0.44提高到0.54。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了语言模型在处理特定变体语言（特别是俚语表达）时，生成和判别能力之间存在根本性不对称性，即使是在英语这种技术丰富的语言中也是如此。
AI.translation: 语言模型在处理非标准语言变体文本时表现出系统性性能差距，但其理解特定方言俚语的能力在多种语言中仍未得到充分探索。我们对七种最先进的语言模型在印度英语（en-IN）和澳大利亚英语（en-AU）俚语意识方面进行了全面评估。我们构建了两个互补数据集：\textsc{web}，包含来自Urban Dictionary的377个网络源用法示例；以及\textsc{gen}，包含1,492个在不同场景下合成生成的俚语用法。我们通过三项任务评估语言模型：目标词预测（TWP）、引导目标词预测（TWP$^*$）和目标词选择（TWS）。我们的结果揭示了四个关键发现：(1) TWS任务的平均模型性能高于TWP和TWP$^*$，平均准确率分别从0.03提高到0.49。(2) \textsc{web}数据集上的平均模型性能强于\textsc{gen}数据集，在TWP和TWP$^*$任务中，平均相似度得分分别提高了0.03和0.05。(3) 在所有模型和数据集上取平均值时，en-IN任务的表现优于en-AU，其中TWS任务的差异最大，平均准确率从0.44提高到0.54。这些发现强调了语言模型在处理特定变体语言（特别是俚语表达）时，生成和判别能力之间存在根本性不对称性，即使是在英语这种技术丰富的语言中也是如此。
AI.summary: 本文评估了七种先进语言模型对印度英语和澳大利亚英语俚语的理解能力。研究构建了包含网络源和合成生成俚语用法的数据集，并通过目标词预测和选择任务进行评估。结果显示，模型在目标词选择任务上表现最佳，在真实网络数据上优于合成数据，且对印度英语的理解优于澳大利亚英语。这揭示了模型在处理特定方言俚语时，生成和判别能力存在不对称性。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 俚语, 印度英语, 澳大利亚英语, 性能评估
AI.comments: 这项研究通过构建特定方言俚语数据集并进行多任务评估，深入揭示了当前语言模型在处理非标准语言变体时的局限性。其创新之处在于关注了以往未被充分探索的特定国家/地区英语俚语，并提出了生成与判别能力不对称的观点。这对于未来改进语言模型在多语言和多方言环境下的鲁棒性和公平性具有重要指导意义。

title: A Unified Evaluation of Learning-Based Similarity Techniques for Malware Detection
summary: Cryptographic digests (e.g., MD5, SHA-256) are designed to provide exact identity. Any single-bit change in the input produces a completely different hash, which is ideal for integrity verification but limits their usefulness in many real-world tasks like threat hunting, malware analysis and digital forensics, where adversaries routinely introduce minor transformations. Similarity-based techniques address this limitation by enabling approximate matching, allowing related byte sequences to produce measurably similar fingerprints. Modern enterprises manage tens of thousands of endpoints with billions of files, making the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed techniques more important than ever in security applications. Security researchers have proposed a range of approaches, including similarity digests and locality-sensitive hashes (e.g., ssdeep, sdhash, TLSH), as well as more recent machine-learning-based methods that generate embeddings from file features. However, these techniques have largely been evaluated in isolation, using disparate datasets and evaluation criteria. This paper presents a systematic comparison of learning-based classification and similarity methods using large, publicly available datasets. We evaluate each method under a unified experimental framework with industry-accepted metrics. To our knowledge, this is the first reproducible study to benchmark these diverse learning-based similarity techniques side by side for real-world security workloads. Our results show that no single approach performs well across all dimensions; instead, each exhibits distinct trade-offs, indicating that effective malware analysis and threat-hunting platforms must combine complementary classification and similarity techniques rather than rely on a single method.

AI.title_translation: 面向恶意软件检测的学习式相似度技术统一评测
AI.tldr: 论文在统一框架下，用大规模公开数据集对多种学习式相似度与分类方法进行对比，发现没有单一技术在所有指标上占优，实际系统应组合多种方法以提升恶意软件检测与威胁狩猎效果。
AI.motivation: 传统密码学摘要（如 MD5、SHA-256）只支持精确匹配，对仅有微小变形的恶意样本无能为力；现有相似度技术虽然能做近似匹配，但评测各自为战、数据集和指标不统一，缺乏可复现的系统性对比，这在管理海量终端和文件的企业安全场景中成为突出问题。
AI.method: 构建统一的实验评测框架，选取多种基于学习的分类与相似度方法（包括相似摘要、局部敏感哈希及从文件特征学习嵌入的模型），在大规模、公开可获取的数据集上进行对比实验，并采用业界认可的评测指标，给出可复现的对标结果。
AI.result: 评测结果表明，没有任一单一方法能在所有维度上表现最佳；不同方法在准确性、可扩展性等方面各有优劣和权衡。
AI.conclusion: 有效的恶意软件分析与威胁狩猎平台不应依赖单一相似度或分类技术，而应综合利用多种互补的学习式分类与相似性方法；同时，统一、可复现的评测框架对理解这些技术的适用性和局限性至关重要。
AI.translation: 密码学摘要（例如 MD5、SHA-256）被设计用来提供精确身份识别。对输入的任意一位进行修改都会产生完全不同的哈希值，这一特性非常适合完整性验证，但在很多现实任务中（如威胁狩猎、恶意软件分析和数字取证）却限制了其实用性，因为对手经常只进行轻微的变形。基于相似度的技术通过支持近似匹配来解决这一局限，使得相关的字节序列能够产生可度量的相似指纹。现代企业需要管理成千上万终端上的数十亿文件，这使得这些相似度技术在安全应用中的有效性和可扩展性变得前所未有地重要。安全研究人员已经提出了一系列方法，包括相似摘要和局部敏感哈希（例如 ssdeep、sdhash、TLSH），以及最近基于机器学习、从文件特征生成嵌入的技术。然而，这些技术大多是被孤立地评估，使用不同的数据集和评测标准。本文使用大型、公开可用的数据集，对基于学习的分类与相似性方法进行了系统比较。我们在统一的实验框架下，采用业界认可的指标对每种方法进行评估。据我们所知，这是首个在真实世界安全负载下，将这些多样的学习式相似度技术放在同一平台上进行可复现基准测试的研究。我们的结果显示，没有单一方法能在所有维度上表现良好；相反，每种方法都表现出独特的权衡，这表明要构建有效的恶意软件分析和威胁狩猎平台，必须结合互补的分类与相似性技术，而不能依赖单一方法。
AI.summary: 本文关注在恶意软件检测与威胁狩猎中，传统密码哈希无法处理“轻微变形但语义相近”文件的问题。作者系统性对比了多种基于学习的相似度与分类技术（包括相似摘要、局部敏感哈希以及嵌入式模型），在大规模公开数据集和统一实验框架下，用业界通用指标进行可复现评测。结果发现，各方法在准确率、鲁棒性和可扩展性等维度上存在明显性能差异与权衡，无法由单一技术通吃所有场景，因此现实世界的安全平台应组合使用多种互补方法，以提升恶意软件分析与威胁狩猎的整体效果。
AI.keywords: 恶意软件检测, 相似度哈希, 学习式嵌入, 近似匹配, 安全评测基准, 威胁狩猎, 大规模公开数据集
AI.comments: 论文的主要贡献是提供一个统一、可复现的评测框架和对多种学习式相似度技术的系统对比，强调“没有银弹”并倡导方法组合。具体模型结构、特征类型、数据集细节以及各方法的量化指标在摘要中未给出，实际应用时仍需关注部署复杂度、实时性和对新变种的泛化能力。

title: Orchestration-Free Customer Service Automation: A Privacy-Preserving and Flowchart-Guided Framework
summary: Customer service automation has seen growing demand within digital transformation. Existing approaches either rely on modular system designs with extensive agent orchestration or employ over-simplified instruction schemas, providing limited guidance and poor generalizability. This paper introduces an orchestration-free framework using Task-Oriented Flowcharts (TOFs) to enable end-to-end automation without manual intervention. We first define the components and evaluation metrics for TOFs, then formalize a cost-efficient flowchart construction algorithm to abstract procedural knowledge from service dialogues. We emphasize local deployment of small language models and propose decentralized distillation with flowcharts to mitigate data scarcity and privacy issues in model training. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness in various service tasks, with superior quantitative and application performance compared to strong baselines and market products. By releasing a web-based system demonstration with case studies, we aim to promote streamlined creation of future service automation.

AI.title_translation: 无需编排的客户服务自动化：一个隐私保护和流程图指导的框架
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于任务流程图（TOFs）的客户服务自动化新框架，它不需要复杂的系统编排，并通过本地模型和去中心化蒸馏来保护用户隐私和解决数据不足，实验结果表明其性能优秀。
AI.motivation: 现有客户服务自动化方法要么依赖于需要大量代理编排的模块化系统设计，要么采用过于简化的指令模式，导致指导有限和泛化能力差。
AI.method: 定义了任务导向流程图（TOFs）的组件和评估指标，形式化了一种成本效益高的流程图构建算法，用于从服务对话中抽象程序知识，并提出使用流程图进行去中心化蒸馏，同时强调本地部署小型语言模型。
AI.result: 实验验证了该框架在各种服务任务中的有效性，在定量和应用性能上优于强大的基线和市场产品。
AI.conclusion: 通过发布基于网络的系统演示和案例研究，旨在促进未来服务自动化的简化创建。
AI.translation: 客户服务自动化在数字化转型中需求日益增长。现有方法要么依赖于需要大量代理编排的模块化系统设计，要么采用过于简化的指令模式，提供的指导有限且泛化能力差。本文引入了一种无需编排的框架，使用任务导向流程图（TOFs）来实现端到端自动化，无需人工干预。我们首先定义了TOFs的组件和评估指标，然后形式化了一种成本效益高的流程图构建算法，用于从服务对话中抽象程序知识。我们强调小型语言模型的本地部署，并提出使用流程图进行去中心化蒸馏，以减轻模型训练中的数据稀缺和隐私问题。广泛的实验验证了其在各种服务任务中的有效性，在定量和应用性能上优于强大的基线和市场产品。通过发布一个带有案例研究的基于网络的系统演示，我们旨在促进未来服务自动化的简化创建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无需编排的客户服务自动化框架，利用任务导向流程图（TOFs）实现端到端自动化。该方法通过流程图构建算法抽象知识，并采用本地部署的小型语言模型和去中心化蒸馏来解决数据稀疏和隐私问题，实验证明其性能优于现有方案。
AI.keywords: 无需编排, 客户服务自动化, 任务导向流程图, 隐私保护, 去中心化蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“无需编排”的客户服务自动化框架，通过任务导向流程图（TOFs）指导，并在本地部署小语言模型并采用去中心化蒸馏，有效解决了现有方法的编排复杂性和隐私数据问题。其重要性在于为端到端自动化提供了一种更易于实现且保护隐私的范式。局限性方面，虽然声称性能优越，但摘要未详细说明与其他最先进方法的具体对比细节。

title: Making Large Language Models Speak Tulu: Structured Prompting for an Extremely Low-Resource Language
summary: Can large language models converse in languages virtually absent from their training data? We investigate this question through a case study on Tulu, a Dravidian language with over 2 million speakers but minimal digital presence. Rather than fine-tuning an LLM, we examine whether structured prompts alone can elicit basic conversational ability under controlled prompting. We systematically tackle various challenges posed by absence of training data for Tulu by combining explicit grammar documentation, negative constraints to suppress high-probability tokens from related languages, romanization standardization, and quality-controlled synthetic data generation via self-play. Evaluated on a manually curated held-out set across three LLMs (Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 70B) and validated by native speakers, our approach reduces vocabulary contamination from 80% to 5% while achieving 85% grammatical accuracy. Cross-model analysis reveals that negative constraints provide consistent improvements (12--18 percentage points), while grammar documentation effects vary by model architecture (8--22 points).

AI.title_translation: 让大语言模型说图鲁语：面向极低资源语言的结构化提示
AI.tldr: 作者仅用结构化提示（无微调）就让LLM在数字资源极少的图鲁语上实现85%语法正确率，核心技巧是“负约束”压制相关语言高概率词。
AI.motivation: 验证当训练语料几乎为零时，大型语言模型能否仅凭提示词学会一种拥有200万使用者却数字资源匮乏的德拉维语——图鲁语。
AI.method: 不微调模型，而是系统整合：显式语法文档、负约束抑制相关语言高频词、罗马字标准化、自博弈生成质控合成数据，并用结构化提示统一输入。
AI.result: 在Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1 70B上，词表污染从80%降至5%，语法准确率85%；负约束带来12–18个百分点稳定提升，语法文档效果因模型架构差异为8–22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 即使训练数据极少，结构化提示足以激发LLM的基础对话能力，负约束是跨模型通用的关键策略。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型能否在训练数据中几乎不存在的语言中进行对话？我们以图鲁语为案例进行研究。该语言属于德拉维语系，使用者超200万却数字资源稀缺。我们不微调LLM，而是检验结构化提示本身能否在受控提示下激发基本对话能力。通过结合显式语法文档、负约束抑制相关语言高概率词、罗马字标准化及自博弈质控合成数据，系统应对无训练数据带来的挑战。在Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1 70B上评估人工构建的测试集并经母语者验证，词表污染从80%降至5%，语法准确率85%。跨模型分析显示，负约束带来12–18个百分点稳定提升，语法文档效果因模型架构差异为8–22个百分点。
AI.summary: 本文针对数字资源极低的图鲁语，提出无需微调的结构化提示框架，通过负约束等策略显著减少跨语言干扰，使主流LLM获得85%语法准确率，为极低资源语言对话提供可行路径。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型,极低资源语言,图鲁语,结构化提示,负约束,语法文档,自博弈合成数据
AI.comments: 研究首次证明仅靠提示即可让LLM掌握几乎零样本的图鲁语对话，负约束策略简单却跨模型有效，值得在更多极低资源语言上验证。

title: FlashMem: Supporting Modern DNN Workloads on Mobile with GPU Memory Hierarchy Optimizations
summary: The increasing size and complexity of modern deep neural networks (DNNs) pose significant challenges for on-device inference on mobile GPUs, with limited memory and computational resources. Existing DNN acceleration frameworks primarily deploy a weight preloading strategy, where all model parameters are loaded into memory before execution on mobile GPUs. We posit that this approach is not adequate for modern DNN workloads that comprise very large model(s) and possibly execution of several distinct models in succession. In this work, we introduce FlashMem, a memory streaming framework designed to efficiently execute large-scale modern DNNs and multi-DNN workloads while minimizing memory consumption and reducing inference latency. Instead of fully preloading weights, FlashMem statically determines model loading schedules and dynamically streams them on demand, leveraging 2.5D texture memory to minimize data transformations and improve execution efficiency. Experimental results on 11 models demonstrate that FlashMem achieves 2.0x to 8.4x memory reduction and 1.7x to 75.0x speedup compared to existing frameworks, enabling efficient execution of large-scale models and multi-DNN support on resource-constrained mobile GPUs.

AI.title_translation: FlashMem：通过优化 GPU 内存层次在移动端支持现代 DNN 工作负载
AI.tldr: 提出 FlashMem 内存流式框架，用按需权重流式加载和 2.5D 纹理内存优化，在移动 GPU 上显著降低内存占用并加速大模型和多模型 DNN 推理。
AI.motivation: 现代 DNN 模型规模庞大且常需连续运行多个不同模型，而移动 GPU 的内存与算力受限；现有框架采用“全部权重预加载”策略，导致内存压力大、无法高效支持大规模和多 DNN 工作负载，因此需要新的内存与执行策略。
AI.method: 提出 FlashMem 内存流式框架：不再将所有权重一次性预加载到 GPU，而是静态分析并确定模型加载调度，然后在运行时按需动态流式加载权重；同时利用 2.5D 纹理内存组织与访问权重，以减少数据格式转换和访问开销，从而提高执行效率并降低峰值显存使用。
AI.result: 在 11 个模型上实验表明，相比现有框架，FlashMem 将内存占用降低 2.0×–8.4×，推理速度提升 1.7×–75.0×，能够在资源受限的移动 GPU 上高效执行大规模模型并支持多 DNN 工作负载。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合静态加载调度与动态权重流式加载，并利用 2.5D 纹理内存优化数据访问，FlashMem 显著缓解了移动 GPU 上大规模和多 DNN 推理的内存与性能瓶颈，使资源受限设备也能高效运行现代复杂 DNN 工作负载。
AI.translation: 随着现代深度神经网络（DNN）的规模和复杂度不断增加，在内存和计算资源有限的移动 GPU 上进行端侧推理面临重大挑战。现有的 DNN 加速框架主要采用权重预加载策略，即在移动 GPU 上执行前将所有模型参数全部加载到内存中。我们认为，这种方法不足以应对包含超大模型以及需要连续执行多个不同模型的现代 DNN 工作负载。在这项工作中，我们提出了 FlashMem，这是一种内存流式框架，旨在在最小化内存消耗和推理延迟的同时，高效执行大规模现代 DNN 及多 DNN 工作负载。与完全预加载权重不同，FlashMem 通过静态方式确定模型加载调度，并在运行时按需动态流式加载权重；同时利用 2.5D 纹理内存来减少数据转换并提升执行效率。在 11 个模型上的实验结果表明，与现有框架相比，FlashMem 实现了 2.0× 至 8.4× 的内存占用降低以及 1.7× 至 75.0× 的速度提升，从而在资源受限的移动 GPU 上实现了大规模模型的高效执行和多 DNN 支持。
AI.summary: 本文面向内存和算力受限的移动 GPU，针对现有 DNN 框架普遍采用“全模型权重预加载”而难以支撑大模型和多模型推理的问题，提出 FlashMem 内存流式框架。该框架离线静态规划权重加载调度，在推理过程中按需动态流式加载，并利用 2.5D 纹理内存降低数据转换开销和提升访问效率。在 11 个模型上的实验表明，FlashMem 可显著降低内存占用并大幅加速推理，使移动端能够更高效地运行现代复杂 DNN 工作负载。
AI.keywords: FlashMem, 移动 GPU, 深度神经网络, 内存流式加载, 权重按需加载, GPU 内存层次优化, 2.5D 纹理内存, 推理加速, 多 DNN 工作负载, 端侧推理
AI.comments: 摘要清晰说明了问题背景（移动 GPU 内存受限与大/多模型推理矛盾）、核心思路（静态调度 + 动态流式加载 + 2.5D 纹理内存）和定量收益。具体硬件平台、模型类型、是否包含训练或仅推理、带宽与能耗影响等在摘要中未提及，但从描述看这是一个通用的系统层框架工作，主要贡献在于内存管理与调度策略以及与 GPU 纹理内存层次的结合。实际可推广性和对不同网络结构/运行时的兼容性需要正文进一步说明。

title: Fractional-Order Federated Learning
comments: This paper is submitted to IEEE-TAI
summary: Federated learning (FL) allows remote clients to train a global model collaboratively while protecting client privacy. Despite its privacy-preserving benefits, FL has significant drawbacks, including slow convergence, high communication cost, and non-independent-and-identically-distributed (non-IID) data. In this work, we present a novel FedAvg variation called Fractional-Order Federated Averaging (FOFedAvg), which incorporates Fractional-Order Stochastic Gradient Descent (FOSGD) to capture long-range relationships and deeper historical information. By introducing memory-aware fractional-order updates, FOFedAvg improves communication efficiency and accelerates convergence while mitigating instability caused by heterogeneous, non-IID client data. We compare FOFedAvg against a broad set of established federated optimization algorithms on benchmark datasets including MNIST, FEMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, EMNIST, the Cleveland heart disease dataset, Sent140, PneumoniaMNIST, and Edge-IIoTset. Across a range of non-IID partitioning schemes, FOFedAvg is competitive with, and often outperforms, these baselines in terms of test performance and convergence speed. On the theoretical side, we prove that FOFedAvg converges to a stationary point under standard smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions for fractional order $0<α\le 1$. Together, these results show that fractional-order, memory-aware updates can substantially improve the robustness and effectiveness of federated learning, offering a practical path toward distributed training on heterogeneous data.
comment: This paper is submitted to IEEE-TAI

AI.title_translation: 分数阶联邦学习
AI.tldr: 提出在联邦学习中引入分数阶梯度与记忆更新的FOFedAvg方法，使在非IID数据下的收敛速度和性能优于传统FedAvg等基线，并给出理论收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习虽然保护隐私，但存在收敛慢、通信开销大以及客户端数据非IID导致的不稳定等问题，需要更高效且对异质数据更鲁棒的优化方法。
AI.method: 将分数阶随机梯度下降（FOSGD）嵌入FedAvg框架，设计带有长期记忆特性的分数阶更新规则（0<α≤1），使每轮本地更新不仅利用当前梯度，还显式利用较长历史信息，从而得到Fractional-Order Federated Averaging（FOFedAvg）；并在标准平滑与有界方差假设下进行理论收敛分析。
AI.result: 在MNIST、FEMNIST、CIFAR-10/100、EMNIST、Cleveland心脏病、Sent140、PneumoniaMNIST和Edge-IIoTset等数据集及多种非IID划分方案上，FOFedAvg与多种主流联邦优化算法相比具有更快的收敛速度和更优或相当的测试性能，并提升了通信效率；理论上证明在0<α≤1时可收敛到平稳点。
AI.conclusion: 在联邦学习中采用分数阶、具记忆性的更新可以有效缓解非IID与异质性带来的不稳定，提升通信效率与收敛性能，为在异构数据上的分布式训练提供了一条实用路径。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）允许远程客户端在保护隐私的同时协同训练全局模型。尽管具有隐私保护优势，FL仍存在显著缺点，包括收敛缓慢、通信成本高以及数据非独立同分布（non-IID）等问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的FedAvg变体——分数阶联邦平均（Fractional-Order Federated Averaging, FOFedAvg），其引入了分数阶随机梯度下降（Fractional-Order Stochastic Gradient Descent, FOSGD），以捕获长程依赖关系和更深层次的历史信息。通过引入具备记忆特性的分数阶更新，FOFedAvg在缓解由异构、非IID客户端数据引起的不稳定性的同时，提高了通信效率并加速了收敛。我们在包括MNIST、FEMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、EMNIST、Cleveland心脏病数据集、Sent140、PneumoniaMNIST和Edge-IIoTset在内的基准数据集上，将FOFedAvg与一系列已有的联邦优化算法进行了比较。在多种非IID划分方案下，FOFedAvg在测试性能和收敛速度方面具有竞争力，并且往往优于这些基线方法。在理论方面，我们在分数阶0<α≤1且满足标准光滑性和有界方差假设的条件下，证明了FOFedAvg收敛到一个平稳点。综合来看，这些结果表明，基于分数阶、具有记忆性的更新能够显著提升联邦学习的鲁棒性与有效性，为在异构数据上的分布式训练提供了一条切实可行的路径。
AI.summary: 本文针对联邦学习在隐私保护下仍面临的收敛慢、通信开销大和非IID导致的不稳定等问题，提出了分数阶联邦平均算法FOFedAvg。该方法在传统FedAvg中引入分数阶随机梯度下降，通过记忆式分数阶更新显式利用更长历史信息，从而提升在异构数据场景下的优化效果。实验覆盖多种图像、文本和医疗物联网等数据集及多种非IID划分，结果显示FOFedAvg在测试精度、收敛速度与通信效率方面普遍优于或不逊于现有联邦优化方法。理论上，作者在标准假设下证明了FOFedAvg在0<α≤1时可收敛到平稳点。整体结论是：引入分数阶记忆更新能显著增强联邦学习面对异质数据时的鲁棒性和实用性。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 分数阶随机梯度下降, FOFedAvg, 非IID数据, 通信效率, 收敛速度, 分布式优化, 记忆更新
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将分数阶优化系统性引入联邦学习，并给出较全面的实验与收敛性证明。潜在问题包括：分数阶阶数α的选择与调参成本在实际系统中的影响、在更大规模客户端与更复杂模型（如大规模深度网络）下的可扩展性，以及分数阶更新对设备端计算与存储开销的具体代价，后续可在这些方面进一步评估与优化。

title: Automatic Funny Scene Extraction from Long-form Cinematic Videos
summary: Automatically extracting engaging and high-quality humorous scenes from cinematic titles is pivotal for creating captivating video previews and snackable content, boosting user engagement on streaming platforms. Long-form cinematic titles, with their extended duration and complex narratives, challenge scene localization, while humor's reliance on diverse modalities and its nuanced style add further complexity. This paper introduces an end-to-end system for automatically identifying and ranking humorous scenes from long-form cinematic titles, featuring shot detection, multimodal scene localization, and humor tagging optimized for cinematic content. Key innovations include a novel scene segmentation approach combining visual and textual cues, improved shot representations via guided triplet mining, and a multimodal humor tagging framework leveraging both audio and text. Our system achieves an 18.3% AP improvement over state-of-the-art scene detection on the OVSD dataset and an F1 score of 0.834 for detecting humor in long text. Extensive evaluations across five cinematic titles demonstrate 87% of clips extracted by our pipeline are intended to be funny, while 98% of scenes are accurately localized. With successful generalization to trailers, these results showcase the pipeline's potential to enhance content creation workflows, improve user engagement, and streamline snackable content generation for diverse cinematic media formats.

AI.title_translation: 长篇影院级视频中的自动搞笑片段抽取
AI.tldr: 提出一套端到端系统，从长篇电影中自动定位并排序搞笑场景，在场景分割和幽默检测上显著优于现有方法，可用于预告和短视频内容生产。
AI.motivation: 流媒体平台需要从长篇、叙事复杂的电影中自动抽取有趣且高质量的搞笑片段，用于预览与短视频（snackable content），以提升用户参与度；但长时长、复杂叙事和幽默的多模态、细腻风格使场景定位与幽默识别变得困难。
AI.method: 构建端到端搞笑片段抽取系统，包括：1）镜头检测；2）利用视觉与文本线索的多模态场景定位和新型场景分割方法；3）通过“guided triplet mining”提升镜头表示；4）结合音频和文本的多模态幽默标注框架，并针对影院内容进行优化；同时在长文本上进行幽默检测与排序。
AI.result: 在 OVSD 数据集上，相比最新场景检测方法平均精度（AP）提升 18.3%；在长文本幽默检测任务上取得 F1=0.834；在五部电影上的实验表明，经该流程抽取得到的片段中有 87% 被标注为本意搞笑，且 98% 的场景被准确定位；系统还能良好泛化到电影预告片。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多模态端到端系统能够有效从长篇电影中自动定位并排序搞笑场景，在场景检测与幽默识别上显著超越现有方法，并能泛化到预告片等形式，显示出在内容创作流程优化、提升用户参与度和自动化生成短视频方面的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 从影院级长片中自动抽取引人入胜且高质量的幽默场景，对于构建吸引人的视频预览和“可随手观看”的短内容，从而提升流媒体平台的用户参与度至关重要。长篇影院级作品具有时长长、叙事复杂等特点，给场景定位带来挑战，而幽默又依赖多种模态并具有细腻的风格，使问题更加复杂。本文提出了一套端到端系统，用于从长篇影院级作品中自动识别和排序幽默场景，系统包含镜头检测、多模态场景定位以及针对电影内容优化的幽默标注。其关键创新包括：结合视觉和文本线索的新型场景分割方法；通过引导式三元组挖掘（guided triplet mining）改进镜头表示；以及利用音频和文本的多模态幽默标注框架。我们的系统在 OVSD 数据集上的场景检测平均精度（AP）相比最新方法提升了 18.3%，并在长文本幽默检测上取得了 0.834 的 F1 分数。对五部影院级作品的大量评估显示，由我们的流程抽取的片段中有 87% 的确被设定为搞笑场景，同时 98% 的场景被准确定位。系统还能成功泛化到电影预告片，这些结果表明该流程有潜力用于增强内容创作工作流、提高用户参与度，并为多种影院媒体形式提供高效的短内容生成。
AI.summary: 本文针对从长篇、叙事复杂的电影中自动抽取搞笑片段的需求，提出一套端到端多模态系统，集成镜头检测、多模态场景定位与幽默识别。方法上，在场景分割中联合利用视觉和文本线索，并通过 guided triplet mining 提升镜头特征表达；在幽默识别上构建结合音频与文本的多模态标注与打分框架，专门针对影院内容进行优化。实验表明，该系统在 OVSD 数据集上的场景检测性能超越现有方法 18.3% AP，在长文本幽默检测上 F1 达到 0.834；在五部电影上的评估显示，自动抽取得到的片段中多数（87%）确为本意搞笑场景，且场景定位精度高（98%）。同时该系统能泛化到电影预告片，展现出在自动生成预告片、短视频剪辑和提高流媒体平台用户粘性方面的应用价值。
AI.keywords: 搞笑片段抽取, 长篇影院视频, 多模态学习, 场景分割, 镜头检测, 幽默识别, guided triplet mining, 预告片生成, snackable content
AI.comments: 论文主要贡献在于面向电影场景的端到端多模态管线设计和具体工程改进（多模态场景分割与幽默标注框架），并给出相对充分的定量与定性评估。训练数据规模、标注方式和跨题材、跨语言泛化等细节在摘要中未提及，实际在不同风格文化背景下的幽默识别效果仍需进一步验证。

title: The Vision Wormhole: Latent-Space Communication in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) powered by Large Language Models have unlocked advanced collaborative reasoning, yet they remain shackled by the inefficiency of discrete text communication, which imposes significant runtime overhead and information quantization loss. While latent state transfer offers a high-bandwidth alternative, existing approaches either assume homogeneous sender-receiver architectures or rely on pair-specific learned translators, limiting scalability and modularity across diverse model families with disjoint manifolds. In this work, we propose the Vision Wormhole, a novel framework that repurposes the visual interface of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to enable model-agnostic, text-free communication. By introducing a Universal Visual Codec, we map heterogeneous reasoning traces into a shared continuous latent space and inject them directly into the receiver's visual pathway, effectively treating the vision encoder as a universal port for inter-agent telepathy. Our framework adopts a hub-and-spoke topology to reduce pairwise alignment complexity from O(N^2) to O(N) and leverages a label-free, teacher-student distillation objective to align the high-speed visual channel with the robust reasoning patterns of the text pathway. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous model families (e.g., Qwen-VL, Gemma) demonstrate that the Vision Wormhole reduces end-to-end wall-clock time in controlled comparisons while maintaining reasoning fidelity comparable to standard text-based MAS. Code is available at https://github.com/xz-liu/heterogeneous-latent-mas

AI.title_translation: 视觉虫洞：异质多智能体系统中的潜在空间通信
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Vision Wormhole框架，利用视觉语言模型的视觉接口实现模型无关、无需文本的通信，以减少多智能体系统中基于文本通信的低效问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的多智能体系统依赖于低效的离散文本通信，导致运行时开销和信息量化损失；而现有的潜在状态传输方法要么假设同质架构，要么依赖成对学习的翻译器，限制了在异构模型家族中的可扩展性和模块性。
AI.method: 提出Vision Wormhole框架，引入Universal Visual Codec将异构推理轨迹映射到共享连续潜在空间，并通过视觉编码器将其注入接收器的视觉路径；采用中心辐射型拓扑将成对对齐复杂度从O(N^2)降低到O(N)，并利用无标签的师生蒸馏目标将高速视觉通道与稳健的文本推理模式对齐。
AI.result: 在异质模型家族（如Qwen-VL、Gemma）上的广泛实验表明，Vision Wormhole在受控比较中减少了端到端运行时间，同时保持了与标准基于文本的多智能体系统相当的推理保真度。
AI.conclusion: Vision Wormhole框架通过视觉接口实现了高效、模型无关的通信，克服了文本通信的局限性，提升了异质多智能体系统的可扩展性和性能。
AI.translation: 未在摘要中提及。
AI.summary: 该研究针对多智能体系统中文本通信的低效问题，提出Vision Wormhole框架，利用视觉语言模型的视觉接口作为通用端口，实现异构模型间的潜在空间通信。通过引入共享潜在空间映射和拓扑优化，减少了通信开销并保持了推理质量，实验验证了其在运行时间和保真度上的优势。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 视觉语言模型, 潜在空间通信, 异质模型, 视觉虫洞
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地利用视觉路径作为通信接口，避免了文本量化损失，并通过拓扑和蒸馏技术提升了可扩展性，但摘要未讨论具体应用场景或潜在限制。

title: Bridging Day and Night: Target-Class Hallucination Suppression in Unpaired Image Translation
summary: Day-to-night unpaired image translation is important to downstream tasks but remains challenging due to large appearance shifts and the lack of direct pixel-level supervision. Existing methods often introduce semantic hallucinations, where objects from target classes such as traffic signs and vehicles, as well as man-made light effects, are incorrectly synthesized. These hallucinations significantly degrade downstream performance. We propose a novel framework that detects and suppresses hallucinations of target-class features during unpaired translation. To detect hallucination, we design a dual-head discriminator that additionally performs semantic segmentation to identify hallucinated content in background regions. To suppress these hallucinations, we introduce class-specific prototypes, constructed by aggregating features of annotated target-domain objects, which act as semantic anchors for each class. Built upon a Schrodinger Bridge-based translation model, our framework performs iterative refinement, where detected hallucination features are explicitly pushed away from class prototypes in feature space, thus preserving object semantics across the translation trajectory.Experiments show that our method outperforms existing approaches both qualitatively and quantitatively. On the BDD100K dataset, it improves mAP by 15.5% for day-to-night domain adaptation, with a notable 31.7% gain for classes such as traffic lights that are prone to hallucinations.

AI.title_translation: 连接昼夜：不成对图像翻译中的目标类幻觉抑制
AI.tldr: 提出一种抑制不成对日夜间图像翻译中目标类语义幻觉的新框架。
AI.motivation: 日夜间不成对图像翻译由于外观差异大且缺乏直接像素级监督，现有方法常导致目标类物体（如交通标志、车辆）和人造灯光效果的语义幻觉，严重损害下游任务性能。
AI.method: 采用基于Schrödinger Bridge的翻译模型，设计双头判别器通过语义分割检测背景区域的幻觉内容，并引入类特定原型作为语义锚点；通过迭代优化将检测到的幻觉特征在特征空间中推离类原型。
AI.result: 在BDD100K数据集上，日夜间域自适应任务的mAP提升15.5%，易出现幻觉的类别（如交通灯）增益达31.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不成对图像翻译中有效抑制目标类幻觉，显著提升下游任务性能。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对日夜间不成对图像翻译中目标类语义幻觉问题，提出结合幻觉检测与抑制的框架，通过双头判别器和类原型优化特征空间，实验证明其在性能和特定类别上显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 不成对图像翻译, 语义幻觉, 目标类, Schrödinger Bridge, 域自适应
AI.comments: 创新点在于明确检测和抑制幻觉的联合框架，但对计算复杂度或泛化能力未提及。

title: World-Model-Augmented Web Agents with Action Correction
summary: Web agents based on large language models have demonstrated promising capability in automating web tasks. However, current web agents struggle to reason out sensible actions due to the limitations of predicting environment changes, and might not possess comprehensive awareness of execution risks, prematurely performing risky actions that cause losses and lead to task failure. To address these challenges, we propose WAC, a web agent that integrates model collaboration, consequence simulation, and feedback-driven action refinement. To overcome the cognitive isolation of individual models, we introduce a multi-agent collaboration process that enables an action model to consult a world model as a web-environment expert for strategic guidance; the action model then grounds these suggestions into executable actions, leveraging prior knowledge of environmental state transition dynamics to enhance candidate action proposal. To achieve risk-aware resilient task execution, we introduce a two-stage deduction chain. A world model, specialized in environmental state transitions, simulates action outcomes, which a judge model then scrutinizes to trigger action corrective feedback when necessary. Experiments show that WAC achieves absolute gains of 1.8% on VisualWebArena and 1.3% on Online-Mind2Web.

AI.title_translation: 具备行动校正的世界模型增强型网页智能体
AI.tldr: WAC通过多智能体协作，结合世界模型模拟行动后果并进行反馈驱动校正，以提升网页任务执行的安全性和成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的网页智能体在预测环境变化和感知执行风险方面存在局限，可能导致过早执行风险行动并导致任务失败。
AI.method: 提出WAC，采用多智能体协作流程：动作模型咨询世界模型作为网络环境专家获取战略指导，并将建议转化为可执行行动；引入两阶段推理链，世界模型模拟行动结果，法官模型进行审查并在必要时触发行动校正反馈。
AI.result: 实验表明，WAC在VisualWebArena上取得1.8%的绝对增益，在Online-Mind2Web上取得1.3%的绝对增益。
AI.conclusion: WAC通过模型协作和反馈驱动校正，有效增强了网页智能体的推理能力和风险感知，提升了任务执行的成功率。
AI.translation: 基于世界模型增强的网页智能体及其行动校正机制
AI.summary: 该研究提出WAC网页智能体，通过多智能体协作整合世界模型模拟行动后果，结合反馈驱动的行动校正，以克服当前智能体在环境变化预测和执行风险感知方面的不足，实验证明其在两个基准测试中显著提升了任务成功率。
AI.keywords: 网页智能体，世界模型，行动校正，多智能体协作，风险感知
AI.comments: 方法设计巧妙，结合了模型协作和模拟推理，但实验增益相对较小，可能需进一步验证其通用性和扩展性。

title: Iterative LLM-Based Assertion Generation Using Syntax-Semantic Representations for Functional Coverage-Guided Verification
summary: While leveraging LLMs to automatically generate SystemVerilog assertions (SVAs) from natural language specifications holds great potential, existing techniques face a key challenge: LLMs often lack sufficient understanding of IC design, leading to poor assertion quality in a single pass. Therefore, verifying whether the generated assertions effectively cover the functional specifications and designing feedback mechanisms based on this coverage remain significant hurdles. To address these limitations, this paper introduces CoverAssert, a novel iterative framework for optimizing SVA generation with LLMs. The core contribution is a lightweight mechanism for matching generated assertions with specific functional descriptions in the specifications. CoverAssert achieves this by clustering the joint representations of semantic features of LLM-generated assertions and structural features extracted from abstract syntax trees (ASTs) about signals related to assertions, and then mapping them back to the specifications to analyze functional coverage quality. Leveraging this capability, CoverAssert constructs a feedback loop based on functional coverage to guide LLMs in prioritizing uncovered functional points, thereby iteratively improving assertion quality. Experimental evaluations on four open-source designs demonstrate that integrating CoverAssert with state-of-the-art generators, AssertLLM and Spec2Assertion, achieves average improvements of 9.57 % in branch coverage, 9.64 % in statement coverage, and 15.69 % in toggle coverage.

AI.title_translation: 基于语法–语义表示的迭代式大模型断言生成：面向功能覆盖引导的验证
AI.tldr: 提出 CoverAssert 框架，通过对断言语义与语法结构的联合聚类评估功能覆盖，并将结果作为反馈引导大模型迭代生成 SystemVerilog 断言，从而显著提升覆盖率与断言质量。
AI.motivation: 现有利用大语言模型从自然语言规格自动生成 SystemVerilog 断言的方法，由于缺乏对 IC 设计的充分理解，单次生成的断言质量较差，且难以验证生成断言是否充分覆盖功能规格，也缺乏基于覆盖率的有效反馈机制，因此需要一种能评估和引导断言生成、提升功能覆盖的框架。
AI.method: 提出 CoverAssert 迭代框架：首先从 LLM 生成的断言中提取语义特征，并从与断言相关的信号抽象语法树中提取结构特征；然后对两者的联合表示进行聚类并映射回自然语言规格，用于分析各功能点的覆盖质量；据此构建基于功能覆盖的反馈回路，引导 LLM 优先补充未覆盖或覆盖不足的功能点，迭代优化断言集。
AI.result: 在四个开源设计上的实验表明，将 CoverAssert 集成到两种先进生成器 AssertLLM 和 Spec2Assertion 中，可平均提升 9.57% 的分支覆盖率、9.64% 的语句覆盖率和 15.69% 的翻转（toggle）覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合语义与语法结构的覆盖分析并构建迭代反馈回路，CoverAssert 能有效引导 LLM 生成更高质量的 SystemVerilog 断言，显著提升多种维度的功能覆盖，为自动化断言生成与验证提供了可行且高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 尽管利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言规格自动生成 SystemVerilog 断言（SVA）具有巨大潜力，现有技术仍面临一个关键挑战：LLM 往往缺乏对 IC 设计的充分理解，导致一次生成的断言质量较差。因此，如何验证生成断言是否能够有效覆盖功能规格，以及如何基于该覆盖情况设计反馈机制，仍然是重要难题。为解决这些限制，本文提出了 CoverAssert，这一用于利用 LLM 优化 SVA 生成的全新迭代框架。其核心贡献是提出了一种轻量级机制，用于将生成的断言与规格中的具体功能描述进行匹配。CoverAssert 通过对 LLM 生成断言的语义特征与从与断言相关信号的抽象语法树（AST）中提取的结构特征的联合表示进行聚类，并将聚类结果映射回规格，以分析功能覆盖质量。在此基础上，CoverAssert 构建了一个基于功能覆盖的反馈循环，引导 LLM 优先关注未被覆盖的功能点，从而迭代地提升断言质量。在四个开源设计上的实验评估表明，将 CoverAssert 集成到当前最先进的生成器 AssertLLM 和 Spec2Assertion 中，可分别在分支覆盖率、语句覆盖率和翻转覆盖率方面实现平均 9.57%、9.64% 和 15.69% 的提升。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于大语言模型自动生成 SystemVerilog 断言时理解不足、覆盖难评估的问题，提出 CoverAssert 迭代框架。该方法将断言的语义特征与相关信号 AST 的结构特征进行联合表示和聚类，并映射回自然语言规格以评估功能覆盖；据此形成覆盖驱动的反馈回路，指导模型补充未覆盖功能点。实验表明，CoverAssert 与现有生成器结合后，在分支、语句和翻转覆盖率上均有约 10% 以上的平均提升，证明了该框架在提升自动断言生成质量和验证效果方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, SystemVerilog 断言, 功能覆盖, 覆盖引导验证, 语法语义联合表示, 抽象语法树(AST), 硬件设计验证, 自动化断言生成
AI.comments: 方法的关键在于将语义与结构信息联合建模并用于功能覆盖分析，从而建立闭环反馈，提高 LLM 在硬件断言生成场景的实用性。可能的局限包括：依赖规格文本与设计 AST 的质量与完整性，迭代过程的计算开销和收敛效率在摘要中未讨论。

title: Improving LLM Reliability through Hybrid Abstention and Adaptive Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in production environments face a fundamental safety-utility trade-off either a strict filtering mechanisms prevent harmful outputs but often block benign queries or a relaxed controls risk unsafe content generation. Conventional guardrails based on static rules or fixed confidence thresholds are typically context-insensitive and computationally expensive, resulting in high latency and degraded user experience. To address these limitations, we introduce an adaptive abstention system that dynamically adjusts safety thresholds based on real-time contextual signals such as domain and user history. The proposed framework integrates a multi-dimensional detection architecture composed of five parallel detectors, combined through a hierarchical cascade mechanism to optimize both speed and precision. The cascade design reduces unnecessary computation by progressively filtering queries, achieving substantial latency improvements compared to non-cascaded models and external guardrail systems. Extensive evaluation on mixed and domain-specific workloads demonstrates significant reductions in false positives, particularly in sensitive domains such as medical advice and creative writing. The system maintains high safety precision and near-perfect recall under strict operating modes. Overall, our context-aware abstention framework effectively balances safety and utility while preserving performance, offering a scalable solution for reliable LLM deployment.

AI.title_translation: 通过混合拒绝与自适应检测提升大语言模型可靠性
AI.tldr: 大语言模型安全与效用的权衡难题：传统静态方法高延迟、不敏感，新框架通过自适应动态阈值与并行检测级联，显著降低误报、提升性能。
AI.motivation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.method: 引入自适应拒绝系统，基于实时上下文信号（如领域和用户历史）动态调整安全阈值；采用多维检测架构，含五个并行检测器，通过分层级联机制结合，以优化速度和精度。
AI.result: 在混合和特定领域工作负载上广泛评估，显著减少了误报，尤其在医疗建议和创意写作等敏感领域；系统在严格操作模式下保持高安全精度和接近完美的召回率，级联设计与非级联模型及外部防护系统相比实现了显著延迟改进。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的拒绝框架有效平衡了安全性与效用，同时保持了性能，为大语言模型可靠部署提供了可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 摘要翻译：在生产环境中部署的大语言模型面临安全性与效用的基本权衡——严格的过滤机制虽能阻止有害输出，但常拦截良性查询；宽松的控制则可能生成不安全内容。基于静态规则或固定置信度的传统防护措施通常缺乏上下文敏感性且计算成本高，导致高延迟和用户体验下降。为应对这些局限，我们引入了自适应拒绝系统，基于实时上下文信号（如领域和用户历史）动态调整安全阈值。所提出的框架集成了一个多维检测架构，由五个并行检测器组成，通过分层级联机制结合以优化速度和精度。级联设计通过渐进过滤查询减少了不必要的计算，与非级联模型和外部防护系统相比实现了显著延迟改进。在混合和特定领域工作负载上的广泛评估显示误报显著减少，尤其在医疗建议和创意写作等敏感领域。系统在严格操作模式下保持高安全精度和接近完美的召回率。总体而言，我们的上下文感知拒绝框架有效平衡了安全性与效用，同时保持了性能，为大语言模型可靠部署提供了可扩展的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种自适应拒绝框架以解决大语言模型部署中的安全-效用权衡问题，通过动态调整安全阈值和级联式并行检测架构，显著减少了误报和延迟，在敏感领域表现优异，平衡了安全性、效用和性能。

title: Doubly Stochastic Mean-Shift Clustering
comments: 30 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2511.09202
summary: Standard Mean-Shift algorithms are notoriously sensitive to the bandwidth hyperparameter, particularly in data-scarce regimes where fixed-scale density estimation leads to fragmentation and spurious modes. In this paper, we propose Doubly Stochastic Mean-Shift (DSMS), a novel extension that introduces randomness not only in the trajectory updates but also in the kernel bandwidth itself. By drawing both the data samples and the radius from a continuous uniform distribution at each iteration, DSMS effectively performs a better exploration of the density landscape. We show that this randomized bandwidth policy acts as an implicit regularization mechanism, and provide convergence theoretical results. Comparative experiments on synthetic Gaussian mixtures reveal that DSMS significantly outperforms standard and stochastic Mean-Shift baselines, exhibiting remarkable stability and preventing over-segmentation in sparse clustering scenarios without other performance degradation.
