title: How Well Do Large-Scale Chemical Language Models Transfer to Downstream Tasks?
summary: Chemical Language Models (CLMs) pre-trained on large scale molecular data are widely used for molecular property prediction. However, the common belief that increasing training resources such as model size, dataset size, and training compute improves both pretraining loss and downstream task performance has not been systematically validated in the chemical domain. In this work, we evaluate this assumption by pretraining CLMs while scaling training resources and measuring transfer performance across diverse molecular property prediction (MPP) tasks. We find that while pretraining loss consistently decreases with increased training resources, downstream task performance shows limited improvement. Moreover, alternative metrics based on the Hessian or loss landscape also fail to estimate downstream performance in CLMs. We further identify conditions under which downstream performance saturates or degrades despite continued improvements in pretraining metrics, and analyze the underlying task dependent failure modes through parameter space visualizations. These results expose a gap between pretraining based evaluation and downstream performance, and emphasize the need for model selection and evaluation strategies that explicitly account for downstream task characteristics.

AI.title_translation: 大规模化学语言模型在下游任务中的迁移表现如何？
AI.tldr: 化学语言模型（CLMs）在下游任务中的性能与训练资源（如模型规模、数据集大小和训练计算量）的增加之间缺乏直接线性关系；预训练损失虽改善，但下游任务改进有限或饱和，需开发针对下游特性的评估策略。
AI.motivation: 验证化学领域中训练资源（模型大小、数据集大小和训练计算）的增加是否系统地改善预训练损失和下游任务性能，并评估现有指标（如Hessian或损失景观）对下游性能的预测能力，揭示评估差距。
AI.method: 通过缩放训练资源预训练化学语言模型（CLMs），并测量其在多样分子性质预测（MPP）任务中的迁移性能，使用参数空间可视化分析任务相关的失败模式。
AI.result: 预训练损失随训练资源增加持续下降，但下游任务性能改进有限；替代指标如Hessian或损失景观无法准确估计CLMs的下游性能；在某些条件下下游性能饱和或退化，尽管预训练指标继续改善。
AI.conclusion: 预训练评估与下游性能之间存在差距，强调需要基于下游任务特性设计模型选择和评估策略。
AI.translation: 基于大规模分子数据预训练的化学语言模型广泛用于分子性质预测，但训练资源增加提升预训练损失和下游性能的常见假设未在化学领域得到系统验证。本文通过预训练CLMs并缩放训练资源，评估其在多样MPP任务中的迁移性能，发现预训练损失下降，下游任务改进有限；替代指标失败，下游性能在特定条件下饱和或退化，需参数空间可视化分析失败模式，揭示评估差距并强调需考虑下游特性的评估策略。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究化学语言模型（CLMs）在缩放训练资源（如模型规模、数据集大小）后对下游分子性质预测任务的迁移性能，发现预训练损失虽改善，下游任务性能却未相应提升或出现饱和，传统评估指标如Hessian无效，需参数空间可视化识别失败模式，突出评估策略需针对下游任务定制。
AI.keywords: 化学语言模型，预训练，下游任务，迁移性能，分子性质预测，训练资源缩放，评估指标，参数空间可视化

title: Agentic AI for Cybersecurity: A Meta-Cognitive Architecture for Governable Autonomy
summary: Contemporary AI-driven cybersecurity systems are predominantly architected as model-centric detection and automation pipelines optimized for task-level performance metrics such as accuracy and response latency. While effective for bounded classification tasks, these architectures struggle to support accountable decision-making under adversarial uncertainty, where actions must be justified, governed, and aligned with organizational and regulatory constraints. This paper argues that cybersecurity orchestration should be reconceptualized as an agentic, multi-agent cognitive system, rather than a linear sequence of detection and response components. We introduce a conceptual architectural framework in which heterogeneous AI agents responsible for detection, hypothesis formation, contextual interpretation, explanation, and governance are coordinated through an explicit meta-cognitive judgement function. This function governs decision readiness and dynamically calibrates system autonomy when evidence is incomplete, conflicting, or operationally risky. By synthesizing distributed cognition theory, multi-agent systems research, and responsible AI governance frameworks, we demonstrate that modern security operations already function as distributed cognitive systems, albeit without an explicit organizing principle. Our contribution is to make this cognitive structure architecturally explicit and governable by embedding meta-cognitive judgement as a first-class system function. We discuss implications for security operations centers, accountable autonomy, and the design of next-generation AI-enabled cyber defence architectures. The proposed framework shifts the focus of AI in cybersecurity from optimizing isolated predictions to governing autonomy under uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 用于网络安全的代理式AI：一种可控自主的元认知架构
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种代理式多代理认知架构框架，以元认知判断函数协调AI代理，提升网络安全中的决策问责和自主治理能力，适用于不确定性环境。
AI.motivation: 当前基于模型的网络安全系统在受限分类任务中有效，但在对抗性不确定性下缺乏支持问责决策的能力，无法满足组织和监管约束，需要重构为可治理的自主系统。
AI.method: 引入一个概念性架构框架，通过显式的元认知判断函数协调负责检测、假设形成、上下文解释、解释和治理的异构AI代理，动态校准系统自主性以处理不完整、冲突或操作风险的证据。
AI.result: 框架将网络安全编排重新概念化为代理式多代理认知系统，通过嵌入元认知判断作为一等系统功能，使现代安全操作的认知结构在架构上显式化且可治理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将AI在网络安全中的焦点从优化孤立预测转向在不确定性下治理自主性，对安全运营中心、问责自主和下一代AI驱动网络防御架构设计具有启示意义。
AI.translation: 代理式AI用于网络安全：一种可控自主的元认知架构
AI.summary: 本文认为当前AI驱动的网络安全系统缺乏在不确定性下支持问责决策的能力，因此提出一种代理式多代理认知架构框架，通过元认知判断函数协调异构AI代理，动态校准自主性，使决策可解释、可治理且符合约束，从而提升网络安全编排的问责和效能。
AI.keywords: 代理式AI, 网络安全, 元认知, 自主性, 多代理系统, 问责决策, 认知架构, 治理框架
AI.comments: 摘要未提供实证数据或具体案例验证，框架为概念性，实际应用效果需进一步研究；但创新性地整合分布式认知理论和负责任AI治理，对网络安全领域有潜在重要影响。

title: Who is the richest club in the championship? Detecting and Rewriting Underspecified Questions Improve QA Performance
comments: 4 pages of main text, 13 pages in total, 5 tables and 10 figures in total
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on well-posed questions, yet standard question-answering (QA) benchmarks remain far from solved. We argue that this gap is partly due to underspecified questions - queries whose interpretation cannot be uniquely determined without additional context. To test this hypothesis, we introduce an LLM-based classifier to identify underspecified questions and apply it to several widely used QA datasets, finding that 16% to over 50% of benchmark questions are underspecified and that LLMs perform significantly worse on them. To isolate the effect of underspecification, we conduct a controlled rewriting experiment that serves as an upper-bound analysis, rewriting underspecified questions into fully specified variants while holding gold answers fixed. QA performance consistently improves under this setting, indicating that many apparent QA failures stem from question underspecification rather than model limitations. Our findings highlight underspecification as an important confound in QA evaluation and motivate greater attention to question clarity in benchmark design.
comment: 4 pages of main text, 13 pages in total, 5 tables and 10 figures in total

AI.title_translation: 冠军联赛中最富有的俱乐部是哪支？检测和改写未明确问题提升QA性能
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在标准QA基准测试中表现不佳，部分原因是存在大量未明确问题（占比16%-50%）。通过检测并改写这些问题，QA性能得到提升，表明问题本身的不明确性是评估中的混淆因素。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在明确问题上表现良好，但标准QA基准测试仍未解决，我们假设这是由于未明确问题（缺乏额外语境无法唯一解释的查询）导致的性能差距。
AI.method: 引入基于LLM的分类器来识别未明确问题，并将其应用于多个广泛使用的QA数据集；进行受控改写实验，将未明确问题改写为完全明确的变体，同时保持答案不变，以分析效果上限。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，16%至超过50%的问题被识别为未明确；LLMs在这些问题上表现显著较差；在改写为明确问题后，QA性能一致提升，表明许多QA失败源于问题未明确而非模型限制。
AI.conclusion: 未明确性是QA评估中的重要混淆因素，研究结果强调了在基准设计中提高问题清晰度的重要性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在明确问题上表现良好，但标准问答（QA）基准测试仍远未解决。我们认为这种差距部分是由于未明确问题——没有额外语境就无法唯一确定解释的查询。为了验证这一假设，我们引入了基于LLM的分类器来识别未明确问题，并将其应用于多个广泛使用的QA数据集，发现16%至超过50%的基准问题是未明确的，且LLMs在这些问题上表现显著较差。为了隔离未明确性的影响，我们进行了受控改写实验，作为上限分析，将未明确问题改写为完全明确的变体，同时保持标准答案固定。在此设置下，QA性能一致提升，表明许多明显的QA失败源于问题未明确而非模型限制。我们的发现突显了未明确性是QA评估中的重要混淆因素，并激励在基准设计中更加关注问题清晰度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型在标准QA基准测试中表现不佳的原因，指出未明确问题（占比16%-50%）是主要因素。通过开发LLM分类器检测这类问题并进行改写实验，发现QA性能提升，从而证明问题不明确性而非模型能力不足导致评估偏差。这强调了改进基准测试设计以提高问题清晰度的必要性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, QA基准测试, 未明确问题, 问题改写, 性能评估
AI.comments: 论文提出了一个有趣的观点，将QA性能差距归因于问题本身的不明确性而非模型缺陷。实验设计合理，但可能依赖于LLM分类器的准确性，且未讨论改写过程的具体挑战或对其他任务的影响。

title: "Sorry, I Didn't Catch That": How Speech Models Miss What Matters Most
summary: Despite speech recognition systems achieving low word error rates on standard benchmarks, they often fail on short, high-stakes utterances in real-world deployments. Here, we study this failure mode in a high-stakes task: the transcription of U.S. street names as spoken by U.S. participants. We evaluate 15 models from OpenAI, Deepgram, Google, and Microsoft on recordings from linguistically diverse U.S. speakers and find an average transcription error rate of 44%. We quantify the downstream impact of failed transcriptions by geographic locations and show that mis-transcriptions systematically cause errors for all speakers, but that routing distance errors are twice as large for non-English primary speakers compared to English primary speakers. To mitigate this harm, we introduce a synthetic data generation approach that produces diverse pronunciations of named entities using open-source text-to-speech models. Fine-tuning with less than 1,000 synthetic samples improves street name transcription accuracy by nearly 60% (relative to base models) for non-English primary speakers. Our results highlight a critical gap between benchmark performance and real-world reliability in speech systems and demonstrate a simple, scalable path to reducing high-stakes transcription errors.

AI.title_translation: "抱歉，我没听清": 语音模型如何遗漏最关键信息
AI.tldr: 语音识别模型在真实场景高风险的短话语中表现不佳，对街道名称转录的平均错误率达44%。 提出基于合成数据的微调方法显著提升了非英语母语使用者的准确性。
AI.motivation: 语音识别系统虽然在标准评测中词错误率低，但在真实世界部署中易对高风险短话语(如街道名称转录)失败，影响实际可靠性。
AI.method: 评估15个商用语音模型(OpenAI、Deepgram、Google、Microsoft)对多样化美国说话者的街道名称转录表现；提出利用开源文本转语音模型生成多元化发音合成数据，并用少于1000个合成样本微调模型。
AI.result: 平均转录错误率达44%；错误对所有说话者均造成系统性影响，但非英语母语使用者的路径距离错误是英语母语使用者的两倍；微调后非英语母语使用者的街道名称转录准确率相对基础模型提升近60%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了语音系统基准表现与真实世界可靠性间的关键差距，并证明通过简单可扩展的合成数据方法可有效减少高风险转录错误。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 研究显示，尽管语音识别系统在标准评测中表现良好，但对美国街道名称等高风险短话语的转录平均错误率高达44%，且对非英语母语者影响更严重。通过合成多元化发音数据并微调模型，可用少量数据显著提升转录准确性，弥合基准与实用性能差距。
AI.keywords: 语音识别, 真实世界可靠性, 转录错误, 高风险话语, 合成数据, 微调, 公平性, 街道名称
AI.comments: 该研究敏锐指出了语音技术在实用场景中的局限性，特别是对少数语言群体的公平性问题。提出的合成数据方法简洁有效，但未讨论该方法在更广泛语音任务中的泛化能力及合成数据与真实数据的差异影响。

title: Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward
summary: The transition from monolithic language models to modular, skill-equipped agents marks a defining shift in how large language models (LLMs) are deployed in practice. Rather than encoding all procedural knowledge within model weights, agent skills -- composable packages of instructions, code, and resources that agents load on demand -- enable dynamic capability extension without retraining. It is formalized in a paradigm of progressive disclosure, portable skill definitions, and integration with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This survey provides a comprehensive treatment of the agent skills landscape, as it has rapidly evolved during the last few months. We organize the field along four axes: (i) architectural foundations, examining the SKILL$.$md specification, progressive context loading, and the complementary roles of skills and MCP; (ii) skill acquisition, covering reinforcement learning with skill libraries, autonomous skill discovery (SEAgent), and compositional skill synthesis; (iii) deployment at scale, including the computer-use agent (CUA) stack, GUI grounding advances, and benchmark progress on OSWorld and SWE-bench; and (iv) security, where recent empirical analyses reveal that 26.1% of community-contributed skills contain vulnerabilities, motivating our proposed Skill Trust and Lifecycle Governance Framework -- a four-tier, gate-based permission model that maps skill provenance to graduated deployment capabilities. We identify seven open challenges -- from cross-platform skill portability to capability-based permission models -- and propose a research agenda for realizing trustworthy, self-improving skill ecosystems. Unlike prior surveys that broadly cover LLM agents or tool use, this work focuses specifically on the emerging skill abstraction layer and its implications for the next generation of agentic systems. Project repo: https://github.com/scienceaix/agentskills

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型的代理技能：架构、获取、安全与未来路径
AI.tldr: 本文综述了从单体语言模型向模块化、技能驱动的代理的转型，重点关注技能架构、获取方法、规模化部署及安全挑战。
AI.motivation: 推动从单体大型语言模型（LLMs）向模块化、动态加载技能的代理转变，以在不重新训练的情况下扩展能力，提升代理系统的灵活性和效率。
AI.method: 综述了技能架构的基础（如SKILL.md规范、渐进上下文加载）、技能获取（如强化学习、自主发现、组合合成）、规模化部署（如计算机使用代理栈、GUI基础、基准测试进展）及安全框架（如四级权限模型）。
AI.result: 本文综合分析了技能生态系统的现状，揭示了社区贡献的技能中26.1%存在漏洞，并提出了技能信任与生命周期治理框架以应对安全挑战。
AI.conclusion: 技能抽象层是下一代代理系统的关键，但面临跨平台可移植性等开放挑战；需通过研究议程推动可信、自我改进的技能生态系统发展。
AI.translation: 论文标题：大型语言模型的代理技能：架构、获取、安全与未来路径；摘要：从单体语言模型到模块化、具备技能的代理的转变，标志着大型语言模型在实践中部署方式的根本性变革。通过动态加载组合指令、代码和资源的技能，代理能力得以扩展而无需重新训练。该范式采用渐进披露、可移植技能定义，并与模型上下文协议整合。本文全面综述了快速发展中的技能领域，从四个维度展开：(i) 架构基础；(ii) 技能获取；(iii) 规模化部署；(iv) 安全挑战。本文还识别了七个开放挑战，并提出研究议程，旨在实现可信、自我改进的技能生态系统。
AI.summary: 本文是一篇关于大型语言模型代理技能的综述，系统阐述了从单体模型到技能驱动代理的转型，涵盖架构设计、技能获取方法、规模化部署实践和安全治理框架，并指出未来研究方向以构建更可靠的技能生态系统。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 代理技能, 技能架构, 技能获取, 安全框架
AI.comments: 本文聚焦于技能抽象层的深入分析，区别于广泛覆盖LLM代理或工具使用的先前综述；提供了具体的实证数据（如技能漏洞比例）和治理框架提案，具有实践指导意义。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Recovery-based Shielding with Gaussian Process Dynamics Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for optimal decision-making and control but often lacks provable guarantees for safety-critical applications. In this paper, we introduce a novel recovery-based shielding framework that enables safe RL with a provable safety lower bound for unknown and non-linear continuous dynamical systems. The proposed approach integrates a backup policy (shield) with the RL agent, leveraging Gaussian process (GP) based uncertainty quantification to predict potential violations of safety constraints, dynamically recovering to safe trajectories only when necessary. Experience gathered by the 'shielded' agent is used to construct the GP models, with policy optimization via internal model-based sampling - enabling unrestricted exploration and sample efficient learning, without compromising safety. Empirically our approach demonstrates strong performance and strict safety-compliance on a suite of continuous control environments.

AI.title_translation: 基于恢复的屏蔽与高斯过程动力学模型的安全强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种结合恢复型屏蔽策略与高斯过程不确定性建模的方法，在未知非线性连续系统中实现带有可证明安全下界的安全强化学习，并在连续控制任务中兼顾性能与严格安全性。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习缺乏对安全性的可证明保证，尤其是在未知、非线性、连续动力学且安全约束关键的场景中，因此需要一种在探索和性能优化的同时仍能确保安全、并具备理论安全下界的方法。
AI.method: 构建一个“恢复型屏蔽”框架：将备份策略（shield）与RL智能体集成，利用基于高斯过程的动力学与不确定性估计预测未来是否可能违反安全约束；若预测存在风险，则动态切换到备份策略以恢复到安全轨迹。智能体在屏蔽保护下收集的数据用于训练GP模型，并通过内部基于模型的采样进行策略优化，从而在不牺牲安全性的前提下进行不受限探索且提高样本效率；同时给出安全性的理论下界保证。
AI.result: 在一组连续控制环境上，所提出方法在经验结果中表现出较强的控制性能，并在整个训练与执行过程中严格遵守安全约束。
AI.conclusion: 恢复型屏蔽结合高斯过程动态建模可以在未知非线性连续系统中实现具有可证明安全下界的安全强化学习，在保证严格安全性的同时保持良好控制性能与样本效率。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）是用于最优决策与控制的强大框架，但在安全关键应用中往往缺乏可证明的安全保证。本文提出了一种新颖的基于恢复的屏蔽框架，使得在未知、非线性的连续动力系统中实现具有可证明安全下界的安全强化学习。该方法将一个备份策略（屏蔽）与RL智能体集成，利用基于高斯过程（GP）的不确定性量化来预测潜在的安全约束违背，仅在必要时动态地恢复到安全轨迹。由“被屏蔽”的智能体收集到的经验用于构建GP模型，并通过内部基于模型的采样来进行策略优化——在不牺牲安全性的情况下，实现不受限的探索和高样本效率的学习。实验结果表明，该方法在一系列连续控制环境中表现出优异性能，并严格遵守安全性要求。
AI.summary: 本文针对未知、非线性、连续动力系统中的安全强化学习问题，提出一种基于恢复的屏蔽框架。方法通过引入备份策略作为屏蔽，并利用高斯过程对系统动力学和不确定性建模，预测未来是否可能违反安全约束；若存在风险则切换到备份策略，将系统轨迹拉回安全区域。收集到的数据用于迭代训练GP模型，并通过内部的模型采样进行策略优化，从而在理论上提供安全下界的同时，实现不受限探索与样本高效学习。实验在多种连续控制任务中验证了该方法的高性能与严格安全合规性。
AI.keywords: 安全强化学习, 屏蔽策略, 恢复控制, 高斯过程, 不确定性量化, 连续控制, 非线性动力系统, 模型为基础的强化学习, 安全约束, 样本效率
AI.comments: 摘要突出理论安全下界和经验安全性，但未给出具体安全度量方式或与现有安全RL方法的定量对比；屏蔽与RL策略的切换机制和备份策略设计细节有待正文进一步澄清。

title: Discovering the mechanics of ultra-low density elastomeric foams in elite-level racing shoes
summary: Ultra-low-density elastomeric foams enable lightweight systems that combine high compliance with efficient energy return. In high-performance racing shoes, these foams are critical for low weight, high cushioning, and efficient energy return; yet, their constitutive behavior remains difficult to model and poorly understood. Here we integrate mechanical testing and machine learning to discover the mechanics of two ultra-low density elastomeric polymeric foams used in elite-level racing shoes. Across uniaxial tension, confined and unconfined compression, and simple shear, both foams exhibit pronounced tension-compression asymmetry, negligible lateral strains consistent with an effective Poisson's ratio close to zero, and low hysteresis indicative of an efficient energy return. Both foams provide a similar compressive stiffness (268kPa vs. 299kPa), while one foam exhibits nearly double the shear stiffness (219kPa vs. 117kPa), implying a substantially greater lateral stability at a comparable vertical energy return (83% vs. 89%). By integrating these data into constitutive neural networks, paired with sparse regression, we discover compact, interpretable single-invariant models, supplemented by mixed-invariant or principal-stretch based terms, that capture the unique signature of the foams with R2 values close to one. From a human performance perspective, these models enable finite-element and gait-level simulations of high-performance racing shoes to quantify running economy, performance enhancements, and injury risks on an individual athlete level. More broadly, this work establishes a scalable and interpretable approach for constitutive modeling of highly compressible, ultra-light elastomeric foams with applications to wearable technologies, soft robotics, and energy-efficient mobility systems.

AI.title_translation: 揭示精英级竞速鞋中超低密度弹性体泡沫的力学机制
AI.tldr: 结合机械测试与机器学习，揭示了两款竞速鞋中超低密度弹性体泡沫的力学行为，并开发了高精度、可解释的唯象模型。
AI.motivation: 超低密度弹性体泡沫在竞速鞋中至关重要，但其本构行为难以建模且理解不足，需要开发可扩展且可解释的建模方法。
AI.method: 整合了单轴拉伸、受限与非受限压缩、简单剪切等机械测试，并利用机器学习和稀疏回归开发了本构神经网络模型。
AI.result: 两款泡沫均表现出显著拉压不对称性、有效泊松比接近零、低滞后性，且剪切刚度差异大。模型R²接近1，能准确捕捉泡沫独特特征。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的模型可用于竞速鞋的有限元和步态模拟，量化跑步经济性、性能提升及损伤风险，并为可穿戴技术等领域提供了可扩展的建模方法。
AI.translation: 通过整合机械测试与机器学习，发现了精英级竞速鞋中两款超低密度弹性体泡沫的力学行为，开发了紧凑、可解释的本构模型，支持高性能模拟与应用拓展。
AI.summary: 本文研究了竞速鞋中超低密度弹性体泡沫的力学特性，通过多模式机械测试揭示了其拉压不对称、低泊松比和高能量回弹效率等行为。利用机器学习与稀疏回归，构建了高精度、可解释的本构模型，为竞速鞋的个体化性能与风险分析提供了工具，并推广至可穿戴技术、软机器人等领域。
AI.keywords: 超低密度弹性体泡沫，竞速鞋，本构模型，机器学习，能量回弹，可穿戴技术
AI.comments: 研究创新地结合实验与数据驱动方法，解决了高压缩性超轻泡沫的建模难题，模型兼具高精度与物理可解释性，应用前景广泛。

title: SafeFlowMPC: Predictive and Safe Trajectory Planning for Robot Manipulators with Learning-based Policies
summary: The emerging integration of robots into everyday life brings several major challenges. Compared to classical industrial applications, more flexibility is needed in combination with real-time reactivity. Learning-based methods can train powerful policies based on demonstrated trajectories, such that the robot generalizes a task to similar situations. However, these black-box models lack interpretability and rigorous safety guarantees. Optimization-based methods provide these guarantees but lack the required flexibility and generalization capabilities. This work proposes SafeFlowMPC, a combination of flow matching and online optimization to combine the strengths of learning and optimization. This method guarantees safety at all times and is designed to meet the demands of real-time execution by using a suboptimal model-predictive control formulation. SafeFlowMPC achieves strong performance in three real-world experiments on a KUKA 7-DoF manipulator, namely two grasping experiment and a dynamic human-robot object handover experiment. A video of the experiments is available at http://www.acin.tuwien.ac.at/42d6. The code is available at https://github.com/TU-Wien-ACIN-CDS/SafeFlowMPC.

AI.title_translation: SafeFlowMPC: 基于学习策略的机器人操作器的预测性与安全轨迹规划

title: Concatenated Codes for Short-Molecule DNA Storage with Sequencing Channels of Positive Zero-Undetected-Error Capacity
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2511.14284. Correcting a few typos and revising some points
summary: We study the amount of reliable information that can be stored in a DNA-based storage system with noisy sequencing, where each codeword is composed of short DNA molecules. We analyze a concatenated coding scheme, where the outer code is designed to handle the random sampling, while the inner code is designed to handle the random sequencing noise. We assume that the sequencing channel is symmetric and choose the inner coding scheme to be composed by a linear block code and a zero-undetected-error decoder. As a byproduct, the resulting optimal maximum-likelihood decoder land itself for an amenable analysis, and we are able to derive an achievability bound for the scaling of the number of information bits that can be reliably stored. As a result of independent interest, we prove that the average error probability of random linear block codes under zero-undetected-error decoding converges to zero exponentially fast with the block length, as long as its coding rate does not exceed some critical value, which is known to serve as a lower bound to the zero-undetected-error capacity.

AI.title_translation: 具有正零未检错容量的测序信道的短分子DNA存储的级联码
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在噪声测序下，使用短DNA分子组成码字的DNA存储系统中可靠存储信息的能力，采用级联编码方案，外码处理随机采样，内码处理随机测序噪声，并推导了可靠存储信息比特数量的可实现界限。
AI.motivation: 研究在具有噪声测序的DNA存储系统中，特别是当每个码字由短DNA分子组成时，可靠存储的信息量，以优化存储容量和可靠性。
AI.method: 采用级联编码方案：外码处理随机采样，内码由线性分组码和零未检错解码器组成，用于处理对称测序信道的随机噪声，并采用最大似然解码器进行分析，推导可实现界限。
AI.result: 推导了可靠存储信息比特数量缩放的可实现界限，并证明在零未检错解码下，随机线性分组码的平均错误概率随块长度呈指数级收敛到零，只要其编码率不超过某个临界值，该值已知为零未检错容量的下限。
AI.conclusion: 级联编码方案在DNA存储系统中有效处理噪声测序，可靠存储信息量可通过分析推导界限，且零未检错解码在适当编码率下提供指数级错误概率收敛。
AI.translation: 摘要中未提供翻译请求的具体内容，因此基于标题和摘要内容，翻译总结为：研究在短分子DNA存储中，利用级联码处理正零未检错容量的测序信道，以提高存储可靠性和容量。
AI.summary: 本研究分析DNA存储系统在噪声测序下可靠存储信息的能力，采用级联编码方案结合外码和内码处理采样和噪声，推导存储信息量的可实现界限，并证明零未检错解码下线性码的错误概率指数收敛。

title: Curriculum Learning and Pseudo-Labeling Improve the Generalization of Multi-Label Arabic Dialect Identification Models
comments: Accepted at the 13th Workshop on NLP for Similar Languages, Varieties and Dialects (VarDial), co-located with EACL 2026
summary: Being modeled as a single-label classification task for a long time, recent work has argued that Arabic Dialect Identification (ADI) should be framed as a multi-label classification task. However, ADI remains constrained by the availability of single-label datasets, with no large-scale multi-label resources available for training. By analyzing models trained on single-label ADI data, we show that the main difficulty in repurposing such datasets for Multi-Label Arabic Dialect Identification (MLADI) lies in the selection of negative samples, as many sentences treated as negative could be acceptable in multiple dialects. To address these issues, we construct a multi-label dataset by generating automatic multi-label annotations using GPT-4o and binary dialect acceptability classifiers, with aggregation guided by the Arabic Level of Dialectness (ALDi). Afterward, we train a BERT-based multi-label classifier using curriculum learning strategies aligned with dialectal complexity and label cardinality. On the MLADI leaderboard, our best-performing LAHJATBERT model achieves a macro F1 of 0.69, compared to 0.55 for the strongest previously reported system. Code and data are available at https://mohamedalaa9.github.io/lahjatbert/.

AI.title_translation: 课程学习与伪标签提升多标签阿拉伯语方言识别模型的泛化能力
AI.tldr: 将阿拉伯语方言识别从单标签转为多标签任务，利用GPT-4o与可接受性分类器构建多标签数据并结合课程学习训练BERT模型，在MLADI榜单上显著刷新成绩（宏平均F1从0.55提升到0.69）。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语方言识别长期被当作单标签分类，且缺乏大规模多标签数据；直接复用单标签数据会因负样本选择不当而影响多标签建模，因为许多被标为“负”的句子在多个方言中其实是可接受的。
AI.method: 先分析基于单标签数据训练的ADI模型并定位负样本选择问题；再使用GPT-4o和二元方言可接受性分类器自动生成多标签标注，并借助Arabic Level of Dialectness（ALDi）进行标签聚合，构建多标签数据集；随后采用与方言复杂度和标签基数相匹配的课程学习策略，训练基于BERT的多标签分类模型LAHJATBERT。
AI.result: 在MLADI排行榜上，最佳LAHJATBERT模型宏平均F1达到0.69，显著高于此前最强系统的0.55。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动多标签标注与基于方言复杂度的课程学习，可以有效缓解单标签数据在多标签阿拉伯语方言识别中的负样本噪声问题，显著提升模型的泛化与整体性能。
AI.translation: 长期以来，阿拉伯语方言识别（ADI）被建模为单标签分类任务，但近期工作认为该任务应被表述为多标签分类。然⽽，ADI仍受限于仅有单标签数据集可用，缺乏可用于训练的大规模多标签资源。通过分析在单标签ADI数据上训练的模型，我们表明，将此类数据重用于多标签阿拉伯语方言识别（MLADI）的主要困难在于负样本的选择，因为许多被视为负例的句子在多个方言中实际上是可接受的。为解决这些问题，我们利用GPT-4o和二元方言可接受性分类器生成自动多标签标注，并在阿拉伯语方言程度（ALDi）的指导下进行聚合，从而构建一个多标签数据集。随后，我们采用与方言复杂度和标签多寡相匹配的课程学习策略训练一个基于BERT的多标签分类器。在MLADI排行榜上，我们表现最好的LAHJATBERT模型取得了0.69的宏平均F1，相较此前最强系统的0.55有明显提升。代码与数据可在：https://mohamedalaa9.github.io/lahjatbert/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对阿拉伯语方言识别任务由单标签向多标签转变过程中缺乏多标签数据、负样本定义模糊的问题，提出利用GPT-4o与二元可接受性分类器自动生成多标签标注，并用ALDi指标进行聚合构建多标签数据集。作者进一步设计与方言复杂度和标签数量相匹配的课程学习方案，训练BERT多标签模型LAHJATBERT，在MLADI基准上将宏平均F1从0.55提升到0.69。
AI.keywords: 阿拉伯语方言识别, 多标签分类, 课程学习, 伪标签, GPT-4o, 方言可接受性分类器, Arabic Level of Dialectness (ALDi), BERT, LAHJATBERT, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 工作创新点主要在于：将单标签资源转化为多标签标注的自动管线（GPT-4o + 可接受性分类器 + ALDi聚合），以及与方言复杂度和标签基数对齐的课程学习策略；局限性如自动标注误差、对GPT-4o与专用分类器的依赖等在摘要中未详细讨论。

title: Peaceful Anarcho-Accelerationism: Decentralized Full Automation for a Society of Universal Care
summary: Foundational results in machine learning -- the universal approximation theorem and deep reinforcement learning convergence -- imply that the vast majority of instrumental labor can be progressively automated. As this process accelerates, the critical question becomes one of governance: who controls the machines, and toward what ends? This paper introduces anarcho-accelerationism, a sociotechnical framework in which full automation is decentralized, commons-governed, and oriented toward universal care. We propose the Liberation Stack, a layered architecture of energy, manufacturing, food, communication, knowledge, and governance commons, powered by frontier clean energy technologies within an accelerationist ecologism that achieves sustainability through abundance rather than degrowth. We introduce Universal Desired Resources (UDR) as a post-monetary design principle and show that UDR constitutes the most comprehensive intersectional intervention yet proposed: by eliminating the material basis of oppression, it dissolves all axes of structural inequality simultaneously. Drawing on Maslow's hierarchy, we show that the Liberation Stack satisfies basic needs universally, enabling what we term synthetic liberty -- the positive freedom that emerges when commons infrastructure provides the material conditions for genuine autonomy. We establish that the framework respects freedom of faith on principled ontological grounds. We propose a progressive transition from Universal Basic Income to UDR and present empirical evidence from Linux, Wikipedia, Mondragon, and Rojava confirming that commons-based systems operate at scale. A phased roadmap with explicit assumptions and limitations is provided.

AI.title_translation: 和平的无政府加速主义：为全面关怀社会实现去中心化的全面自动化
AI.tldr: 本文提出‘无政府加速主义’框架，通过去中心化的全面自动化实现普遍关怀，采用‘解放栈’分层结构并引入‘普遍所需资源’原则，以消除不平等和保障自主自由。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习发展使大多数劳动自动化，核心问题转向治理：机器由谁控制及目的为何。本文旨在探索去中心化自动化以实现社会普遍关怀。
AI.method: 提出无政府加速主义框架，包括‘解放栈’分层架构（能源、制造、食品、通信、知识、治理公地），结合前沿清洁能源技术和加速主义生态主义，并引入‘普遍所需资源’作为后货币设计原则。
AI.result: 框架通过满足基本需求实现‘合成自由’，尊重信仰自由，并提供从全民基本收入向普遍所需资源过渡的路线图，基于Linux、维基百科等案例证明公地系统可规模化运作。
AI.conclusion: 无政府加速主义通过去中心化自动化和公地治理，可消除结构性不平等，实现物质条件下的真正自主自由，为全面关怀社会提供可行路径。
AI.translation: 和平的无政府加速主义：为全面关怀社会实现去中心化的全面自动化
AI.summary: 本文基于机器学习进步带来的自动化潜力，提出无政府加速主义框架，倡导去中心化、公地治理的全面自动化，并以普遍关怀为目标。通过‘解放栈’架构和‘普遍所需资源’原则，该框架旨在消除不平等、满足基本需求，实现‘合成自由’，并尊重信仰自由，同时提供实证支持和过渡路线图。

title: A Formal Framework for the Explanation of Finite Automata Decisions
summary: Finite automata (FA) are a fundamental computational abstraction that is widely used in practice for various tasks in computer science, linguistics, biology, electrical engineering, and artificial intelligence. Given an input word, an FA maps the word to a result, in the simple case "accept" or "reject", but in general to one of a finite set of results. A question that then arises is: why? Another question is: how can we modify the input word so that it is no longer accepted? One may think that the automaton itself is an adequate explanation of its behaviour, but automata can be very complex and difficult to make sense of directly. In this work, we investigate how to explain the behaviour of an FA on an input word in terms of the word's characters. In particular, we are interested in minimal explanations: what is the minimal set of input characters that explains the result, and what are the minimal changes needed to alter the result? In this paper, we propose an efficient method to determine all minimal explanations for the behaviour of an FA on a particular word. This allows us to give unbiased explanations about which input features are responsible for the result. Experiments show that our approach scales well, even when the underlying problem is challenging.

AI.title_translation: 有限自动机决策解释的形式化框架
AI.tldr: 提出一种高效方法，用于确定有限自动机在特定单词行为上的所有最小解释，以识别负责结果的输入特征。
AI.motivation: 有限自动机在实践中广泛应用，但其复杂行为难以直接理解，需要解释输入单词如何导致特定结果（如接受/拒绝）以及如何修改单词以改变结果。
AI.method: 提出一种高效方法，确定有限自动机在特定单词行为上的所有最小解释，重点关注最小输入字符集解释结果和最小更改以改变结果。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法具有良好的可扩展性，即使底层问题具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能提供无偏解释，识别负责结果的输入特征，增强有限自动机行为的可理解性。
AI.translation: 有限自动机（FA）是计算机科学、语言学、生物学、电气工程和人工智能等领域广泛使用的基本计算抽象。对于输入单词，FA将其映射到结果（简单情况下为“接受”或“拒绝”，但通常为有限结果集）。随之产生的问题是：为什么？另一个问题是：如何修改输入单词使其不再被接受？虽然自动机本身可能是其行为的充分解释，但自动机可能非常复杂且难以直接理解。本研究探讨如何根据单词字符解释FA在输入单词上的行为，特别关注最小解释：解释结果的最小输入字符集是什么？改变结果所需的最小更改是什么？本文提出一种高效方法，确定FA在特定单词行为上的所有最小解释，从而提供关于哪些输入特征负责结果的公正解释。实验表明，即使底层问题具有挑战性，该方法也具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文针对有限自动机行为解释的挑战，提出一种形式化框架和高效算法，用于确定输入单词导致特定结果（如接受/拒绝）的最小字符集解释和最小修改方案。该方法通过分析单词字符，提供无偏且可扩展的解释，增强自动机决策的可理解性，适用于计算机科学、人工智能等多个领域。
AI.keywords: 有限自动机, 行为解释, 最小解释, 输入特征, 可扩展性
AI.comments: 该研究将形式化方法与实际可扩展性结合，为复杂自动机决策提供透明解释，有助于提高自动机在敏感应用（如人工智能决策）中的可信度和可调试性。

title: Search in Transition: A Study of University Students Perspectives on Using LLMs and Traditional Search Engines in English Test Problem Solving for Higher Study
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2510.17726 by other authors
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into education, university students preparing for English language tests are frequently shifting between traditional search engines like Google and large language models (LLMs) to assist with problem-solving. This study explores students perceptions of these tools, particularly in terms of usability, efficiency, and how they fit into English test preparation practices. Using a mixed-methods design, we collected survey data from 140 university students across various academic fields and conducted in-depth interviews with 20 participants. Quantitative analyses, including ANOVA and chi-square tests, were applied to assess differences in perceived efficiency, satisfaction, and overall tool preference. The qualitative results reveal that students strategically alternate between GPT and Google based on task requirements. Google is primarily used for accessing reliable, multi-source information and verifying rules, whereas GPT is favored for summarizing content, providing explanations, paraphrasing, and drafting responses for English test tasks. Since neither tool independently satisfies all aspects of English language test preparation, students expressed a clear preference for an integrated approach. In response, this study proposes a prototype chatbot embedded within a search interface, combining GPTs interactive capabilities with Googles credibility to enhance test preparation and reduce cognitive load.

AI.title_translation: 搜索的转型期：大学生在英语考试备考问题求解中使用大模型与传统搜索引擎的观点研究
AI.tldr: 研究发现，大学生在英语考试备考中会根据任务在Google与GPT间切换，两者各擅其长，学生更偏好将二者整合的混合工具。
AI.motivation: 在AI迅速融入教育的背景下，越来越多大学生在英语考试备考中同时使用传统搜索引擎与大型语言模型，但目前对他们如何看待、使用和权衡这两类工具的系统性研究仍有限，尤其是从可用性、效率和备考实践契合度角度。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：对来自不同专业的140名大学生进行问卷调查，并对其中20名进行深度访谈；定量部分使用ANOVA和卡方检验分析效率感知、满意度和工具偏好差异，定性部分分析学生对Google和GPT使用策略及情境化选择。
AI.result: 学生会根据具体任务在GPT和Google之间策略性切换：Google主要用于获取可靠的多源信息和核查规则；GPT主要用于内容总结、解释说明、改写和英语题目作答草稿。由于单一工具无法满足全部备考需求，多数学生更偏好将二者结合使用，并对一体化解决方案持积极态度。
AI.conclusion: 在英语考试备考场景中，LLM与传统搜索各具优势而难以完全替代对方，学生倾向于混合使用。基于此，作者提出并原型化了一种嵌入搜索界面的聊天机器人，将GPT的交互能力与Google的可信信息来源结合，以期提升备考效率并降低认知负荷。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能（AI）在教育领域的日益融合，正在准备英语语言考试的大学生在求解问题时，越来越频繁地在传统搜索引擎（如Google）与大型语言模型（LLMs）之间切换。本文探讨学生对这些工具的看法，特别是从可用性、效率以及它们与英语考试备考实践的契合度等方面入手。研究采用混合方法设计，收集了来自不同学科领域的140名大学生的问卷数据，并对20名参与者进行了深度访谈。在定量分析中使用了ANOVA和卡方检验，以评估在效率感知、满意度和整体工具偏好方面的差异。定性结果表明，学生会根据任务需求在GPT和Google之间进行策略性切换：Google主要用于获取可靠的、多来源的信息和核查规则，而GPT更受青睐于内容总结、提供解释、改写文本以及为英语考试任务起草作答。由于任何单一工具都无法独立满足英语考试备考的所有方面，学生明确表达了对一种整合式方法的偏好。对此，研究提出了一个嵌入搜索界面的聊天机器人原型，将GPT的交互能力与Google的可信度相结合，以增强备考体验并降低认知负荷。
AI.summary: 本文以英语考试备考为具体情境，考察大学生如何在传统搜索引擎与大型语言模型之间进行选择和组合使用。通过对140份问卷和20次访谈的混合方法分析，研究发现：Google被视为核实规则和获取多源、较高可信度信息的工具，而GPT则更适合用于总结、解释、改写和生成答题草稿。学生通常不会将二者视为互斥，而是基于任务类型进行策略性切换，并普遍认为两类工具整合后的系统更能满足备考需求。基于这一认知与实践模式，作者提出了一个将对话式GPT功能嵌入搜索界面的原型，以在保持信息可信度的同时提高备考效率并减轻认知负担。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 传统搜索引擎, 大学生, 英语考试备考, 信息检索行为, 可用性与效率感知, 混合方法研究, 教育技术
AI.comments: 研究清晰展示了LLM与搜索引擎在真实学习场景中的互补关系，并用原型设计回应学生偏好；但样本集中在特定文化与考试环境，推广到其他语言考试或年龄群体仍需进一步验证。

title: LeafNet: A Large-Scale Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundational Vision-Language Understanding of Plant Diseases
summary: Foundation models and vision-language pre-training have significantly advanced Vision-Language Models (VLMs), enabling multimodal processing of visual and linguistic data. However, their application in domain-specific agricultural tasks, such as plant pathology, remains limited due to the lack of large-scale, comprehensive multimodal image--text datasets and benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce LeafNet, a comprehensive multimodal dataset, and LeafBench, a visual question-answering benchmark developed to systematically evaluate the capabilities of VLMs in understanding plant diseases. The dataset comprises 186,000 leaf digital images spanning 97 disease classes, paired with metadata, generating 13,950 question-answer pairs spanning six critical agricultural tasks. The questions assess various aspects of plant pathology understanding, including visual symptom recognition, taxonomic relationships, and diagnostic reasoning. Benchmarking 12 state-of-the-art VLMs on our LeafBench dataset, we reveal substantial disparity in their disease understanding capabilities. Our study shows performance varies markedly across tasks: binary healthy--diseased classification exceeds 90\% accuracy, while fine-grained pathogen and species identification remains below 65\%. Direct comparison between vision-only models and VLMs demonstrates the critical advantage of multimodal architectures: fine-tuned VLMs outperform traditional vision models, confirming that integrating linguistic representations significantly enhances diagnostic precision. These findings highlight critical gaps in current VLMs for plant pathology applications and underscore the need for LeafBench as a rigorous framework for methodological advancement and progress evaluation toward reliable AI-assisted plant disease diagnosis. Code is available at https://github.com/EnalisUs/LeafBench.

AI.title_translation: LeafNet：用于植物病害基础视觉-语言理解的大规模数据集与全面基准
AI.tldr: 引入 LeafNet 数据集和 LeafBench 基准，评估视觉语言模型在植物病害理解上的表现，发现多模态架构优于纯视觉模型。
AI.motivation: 基础模型和视觉-语言预训练虽已显著推进视觉-语言模型，但在农业领域（如植物病理学）的应用仍受限于缺乏大规模、全面的多模态图像-文本数据集和基准。
AI.method: 构建 LeafNet 数据集（含 186,000 张叶片数字图像，覆盖 97 个病害类别，配以元数据，生成 13,950 个问答对，涵盖六个关键农业任务），并开发 LeafBench 视觉问答基准以系统评估视觉语言模型的能力。
AI.result: 对 12 个最先进的视觉语言模型进行基准测试，显示其在病害理解能力上存在显著差异：二元健康-病害分类准确率超过 90%，而细粒度病原体和物种识别低于 65%。微调后的视觉语言模型优于传统视觉模型，表明整合语言表征能显著提升诊断精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前视觉语言模型在植物病理学应用中的关键差距，并强调 LeafBench 作为严格框架的必要性，以推动方法学进步和评估进展，实现可靠的 AI 辅助植物病害诊断。
AI.translation: 基础模型和视觉-语言预训练已显著推进视觉-语言模型，使其能够处理视觉和语言数据的多模态任务。然而，由于缺乏大规模、全面的多模态图像-文本数据集和基准，它们在农业领域特定任务（如植物病理学）中的应用仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们引入了 LeafNet，一个全面的多模态数据集，以及 LeafBench，一个为系统评估视觉-语言模型在理解植物病害方面的能力而开发的视觉问答基准。该数据集包含 186,000 张叶片数字图像，涵盖 97 个病害类别，配以元数据，生成了 13,950 个问答对，涵盖六个关键农业任务。问题评估了植物病理学理解的各个方面，包括视觉症状识别、分类学关系和诊断推理。对 12 个最先进的视觉-语言模型在我们的 LeafBench 数据集上进行基准测试，揭示了它们在病害理解能力上的显著差异。我们的研究表明，性能在不同任务间差异显著：二元健康-病害分类准确率超过 90%，而细粒度病原体和物种识别仍低于 65%。视觉模型与视觉-语言模型的直接比较显示了多模态架构的关键优势：微调后的视觉-语言模型优于传统视觉模型，证实整合语言表征能显著提升诊断精度。这些发现突出了当前视觉-语言模型在植物病理学应用中的关键差距，并强调了 LeafBench 作为严格框架的必要性，以促进方法学进步和评估进展，实现可靠的 AI 辅助植物病害诊断。代码可在 https://github.com/EnalisUs/LeafBench 获取。
AI.summary: LeafNet 是一个大规模植物病害多模态数据集，包含 186,000 张图像和 13,950 个问答对；LeafBench 是基于此的视觉问答基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在六个农业任务上的表现。研究显示，模型在二元分类任务上表现良好（准确率>90%），但在细粒度识别上不足（<65%），且多模态模型优于纯视觉模型，突出了整合语言信息的重要性。
AI.keywords: 植物病害，视觉-语言模型，多模态数据集，视觉问答基准，农业人工智能，LeafNet，LeafBench，诊断精度
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建专业数据集和基准，系统评估了视觉语言模型在农业领域的应用潜力，强调了多模态方法在提升植物病害诊断准确性的优势，为后续研究提供了重要工具和方向。

title: DTBench: A Synthetic Benchmark for Document-to-Table Extraction
summary: Document-to-table (Doc2Table) extraction derives structured tables from unstructured documents under a target schema, enabling reliable and verifiable SQL-based data analytics. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in flexible information extraction, their ability to produce precisely structured tables remains insufficiently understood, particularly for indirect extraction that requires complex capabilities such as reasoning and conflict resolution. Existing benchmarks neither explicitly distinguish nor comprehensively cover the diverse capabilities required in Doc2Table extraction. We argue that a capability-aware benchmark is essential for systematic evaluation. However, constructing such benchmarks using human-annotated document-table pairs is costly, difficult to scale, and limited in capability coverage. To address this, we adopt a reverse Table2Doc paradigm and design a multi-agent synthesis workflow to generate documents from ground-truth tables. Based on this approach, we present DTBench, a synthetic benchmark that adopts a proposed two-level taxonomy of Doc2Table capabilities, covering 5 major categories and 13 subcategories. We evaluate several mainstream LLMs on DTBench, and demonstrate substantial performance gaps across models, as well as persistent challenges in reasoning, faithfulness, and conflict resolution. DTBench provides a comprehensive testbed for data generation and evaluation, facilitating future research on Doc2Table extraction. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/ZJU-DAILY/DTBench.

AI.title_translation: DTBench：一个面向文档到表格提取的合成基准测试
AI.tldr: 介绍DTBench，一个基于合成文档的文档到表格提取基准测试，采用多代理工作流生成数据，评估大语言模型在结构化表格提取中的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 文档到表格提取可实现可靠的数据分析，但现有基准未全面覆盖所需能力（如推理和冲突解决），且人工标注成本高、难以扩展。
AI.method: 采用反向Table2Doc范式和多代理合成工作流，从真实表格生成文档；提出两级能力分类法（5大类13子类）构建合成基准DTBench。
AI.result: 评估多个主流大语言模型，结果显示模型间性能存在显著差距，在推理、忠实性和冲突解决方面仍面临持续挑战。
AI.conclusion: DTBench为文档到表格提取提供了全面的数据生成和评估测试平台，有助于推动未来研究。
AI.translation: 文档到表格（Doc2Table）提取从非结构化文档中提取结构化表格，支持可靠且可验证的SQL数据分析。虽然大语言模型在灵活信息提取方面有潜力，但其生成精确结构化表格的能力尚未充分理解，特别是需要复杂推理和冲突解决的间接提取。现有基准既未明确区分，也未全面覆盖Doc2Table提取所需的多样能力。我们认为，基于能力的基准对于系统评估至关重要。然而，使用人工标注的文档-表格对构建此类基准成本高、难以扩展且能力覆盖有限。为此，我们采用反向Table2Doc范式，设计多代理合成工作流，从真实表格生成文档。基于此方法，我们提出DTBench，一个采用提议的两级Doc2Table能力分类法（涵盖5个主要类别和13个子类别）的合成基准。我们评估了多个主流大语言模型在DTBench上的表现，展示了模型间的显著性能差距，以及在推理、忠实性和冲突解决方面的持续挑战。DTBench为数据生成和评估提供了全面测试平台，促进了未来对Doc2Table提取的研究。该基准已在https://github.com/ZJU-DAILY/DTBench公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出DTBench，一个用于文档到表格提取的合成基准测试，通过反向生成和多代理工作流创建文档-表格对，覆盖5类13种能力；评估显示大语言模型在该任务上存在性能差距，尤其在推理和冲突解决方面；该基准旨在促进相关研究。
AI.keywords: 文档到表格提取, 基准测试, 大语言模型, 能力评估, 合成数据
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: A Comparative Analysis of Social Network Topology in Reddit and Moltbook
summary: Recent advances in agent-mediated systems have enabled a new paradigm of social network simulation, where AI agents interact with human-like autonomy. This evolution has fostered the emergence of agent-driven social networks such as Moltbook, a Reddit-like platform populated entirely by AI agents. Despite these developments, empirical comparisons between agent-driven and human-driven social networks remain scarce, limiting our understanding of how their network topologies might diverge. This paper presents the first comparative analysis of network topology on Moltbook, utilizing a comment network comprising 33,577 nodes and 697,688 edges. To provide a benchmark, we curated a parallel dataset from Reddit consisting of 7.8 million nodes and 51.8 million edges. We examine key structural differences between agent-drive and human-drive networks, specifically focusing on topological patterns and the edge formation efficacy of their respective posts. Our findings provide a foundational profile of AI-driven social structures, serving as a preliminary step toward developing more robust and authentic agent-mediated social systems.

AI.title_translation: Reddit 与 Moltbook 社交网络拓扑的比较分析
AI.tldr: 本文比较了由人类驱动的 Reddit 与由 AI 代理驱动的 Moltbook 的评论网络拓扑差异，为理解 AI 社交网络结构特性提供初步实证资料。
AI.motivation: 尽管出现了由 AI 代理自主互动构成的社交网络（如 Moltbook），但几乎没有关于这类“代理驱动”网络与传统“人类驱动”社交网络在拓扑结构上的实证比较，限制了我们对 AI 社交系统真实性与有效性的理解，因此需要系统分析二者的网络拓扑差异。
AI.method: 构建并比较两个评论网络：一个来自 AI 代理驱动平台 Moltbook（33,577 个节点、697,688 条边），一个来自人类驱动的 Reddit（780 万节点、5180 万条边）；在这些图结构上分析关键拓扑特征，并比较不同平台帖子在形成边（交互）的效率与结构模式差异。
AI.result: 文章报告了 Moltbook 与 Reddit 在整体拓扑模式及帖子边生成效率方面存在显著结构差异，并给出了 AI 驱动社交网络的基础结构画像；但具体差异的定量指标与数值结果在摘要中未给出（Not mentioned in abstract）。
AI.conclusion: 初步比较表明，AI 代理驱动的社交网络在拓扑结构和交互形成方式上与人类驱动网络存在可观差异，这一基础画像为今后设计更稳健、更贴近人类行为的代理中介社交系统提供了起点和基准。
AI.translation:
论文标题：
Reddit 与 Moltbook 社交网络拓扑的比较分析

摘要：
代理中介系统的最新进展推动了一种新的社交网络仿真范式，在这种范式中，AI 代理以类似人类的自主性进行互动。这一演进催生了诸如 Moltbook 之类的代理驱动社交网络——一个完全由 AI 代理组成、类似 Reddit 的平台。尽管有这些发展，关于代理驱动与人类驱动社交网络之间的实证比较仍然稀缺，这限制了我们理解它们的网络拓扑可能如何分化。本文首次对 Moltbook 上的网络拓扑进行了比较分析，使用了一个包含 33,577 个节点和 697,688 条边的评论网络。为了提供基准，我们从 Reddit 筛选了一个平行数据集，包含 780 万个节点和 5,180 万条边。我们考察了代理驱动与人类驱动网络之间关键的结构差异，具体关注拓扑模式以及各平台帖子在边形成方面的效率。我们的研究结果为 AI 驱动的社会结构提供了基础画像，是迈向更健壮、更真实的代理中介社交系统的初步一步。
AI.summary: 本文利用大规模评论网络数据，对 AI 代理驱动平台 Moltbook 与人类驱动平台 Reddit 的社交网络拓扑进行对比。研究构建了一个包含约 3.3 万节点、近 70 万边的 Moltbook 图，以及一个包含 780 万节点、5,180 万边的 Reddit 图，比较二者在整体拓扑结构和帖子促成边形成效率上的差异。结果给出了 AI 社交网络的基础结构特征画像，为未来设计和评估更接近人类互动模式的代理中介社交系统提供实证基准。
AI.keywords: 社交网络拓扑, Reddit, Moltbook, AI 代理, 代理驱动社交网络, 网络比较分析, 评论网络
AI.comments: 摘要强调的是首个大规模比较 AI 代理与人类社交网络拓扑的工作，突出数据规模和对结构差异的关注，但未给出具体指标和定量结论；后续需查阅正文了解采用的具体网络统计量（如度分布、聚类系数、社区结构、同配性等）以及这些差异对真实性和行为建模的具体影响。

title: HLE-Verified: A Systematic Verification and Structured Revision of Humanity's Last Exam
summary: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) has become a widely used benchmark for evaluating frontier large language models on challenging, multi-domain questions. However, community-led analyses have raised concerns that HLE contains a non-trivial number of noisy items, which can bias evaluation results and distort cross-model comparisons. To address this challenge, we introduce HLE-Verified, a verified and revised version of HLE with a transparent verification protocol and fine-grained error taxonomy. Our construction follows a two-stage validation-and-repair workflow resulting in a certified benchmark. In Stage I, each item undergoes binary validation of the problem and final answer through domain-expert review and model-based cross-checks, yielding 641 verified items. In Stage II, flawed but fixable items are revised under strict constraints preserving the original evaluation intent, through dual independent expert repairs, model-assisted auditing, and final adjudication, resulting in 1,170 revised-and-certified items. The remaining 689 items are released as a documented uncertain set with explicit uncertainty sources and expertise tags for future refinement. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art language models on HLE and HLE-Verified, observing an average absolute accuracy gain of 7--10 percentage points on HLE-Verified. The improvement is particularly pronounced on items where the original problem statement and/or reference answer is erroneous, with gains of 30--40 percentage points. Our analyses further reveal a strong association between model confidence and the presence of errors in the problem statement or reference answer, supporting the effectiveness of our revisions. Overall, HLE-Verified improves HLE-style evaluations by reducing annotation noise and enabling more faithful measurement of model capabilities. Data is available at: https://github.com/SKYLENAGE-AI/HLE-Verified

AI.title_translation: HLE-Verified：对人类最终考试的系统化验证与结构化修订
AI.tldr: 介绍了HLE-Verified，一个经过验证和修订的HLE基准测试版本，包含透明的验证协议和详细的错误分类，旨在减少评估噪声并提高模型能力测量的准确性。
AI.motivation: 社区分析指出HLE基准测试中存在大量噪声项，可能导致评估结果偏差和跨模型比较失真，因此需要构建一个经过验证的修订版本。
AI.method: 采用两阶段工作流程：第一阶段通过领域专家审查和基于模型的交叉检查对问题和最终答案进行二元验证，产生641个验证项；第二阶段对可修复项在严格约束下进行双重独立专家修复、模型辅助审计和最终裁决，产生1,170个修订并认证项，其余689项作为文档化不确定集发布。
AI.result: 在HLE和HLE-Verified上评估七个最先进的语言模型，观察到HLE-Verified上的平均绝对准确率提升7-10个百分点，在问题陈述或参考答案有误的项上增益为30-40个百分点。
AI.conclusion: HLE-Verified通过减少标注噪声，提高了HLE风格评估的忠实度，支持更可靠的模型能力测量。数据已公开发布。
AI.translation: 人类最终考试（HLE）已成为评估前沿大语言模型在挑战性多领域问题上表现的广泛使用基准。但社区分析担忧HLE包含大量噪声项，可能偏置评估结果并扭曲跨模型比较。为应对此挑战，我们引入HLE-Verified，这是一个经过验证和修订的HLE版本，具有透明验证协议和细粒度错误分类。构建遵循两阶段验证与修复工作流程，产生认证基准。第一阶段每项通过领域专家审查和基于模型的交叉检查对问题及最终答案进行二元验证，产生641个验证项。第二阶段对可修复但存在缺陷的项在严格约束下（保留原始评估意图）进行双重独立专家修复、模型辅助审计和最终裁决，产生1,170个修订并认证项。其余689项作为文档化不确定集发布，包含明确的不确定性来源和专业知识标签以供未来改进。我们评估七个最先进语言模型在HLE和HLE-Verified上的表现，观察到HLE-Verified上的平均绝对准确率提升7-10个百分点。改进在原始问题陈述和/或参考答案有误的项上尤为明显，增益为30-40个百分点。分析进一步揭示模型置信度与问题陈述或参考答案错误存在强关联，支持修订的有效性。总体上，HLE-Verified通过减少标注噪声和提高模型能力测量的忠实度，改进了HLE风格评估。数据可从指定网址获取。
AI.summary: HLE-Verified是一个经过系统验证和结构化修订的HLE基准测试版本，旨在解决原基准中噪声项导致的评估偏差问题。通过两阶段验证与修复流程，产生了认证项和不确定集，评估显示修订后模型准确率显著提升，尤其在错误项上改进明显，支持更可靠的模型比较。
AI.keywords: HLE-Verified, 基准测试验证, 语言模型评估, 标注噪声减少, 结构化修订
AI.comments: 该工作针对现有基准测试的局限性，提出了透明的验证和修订方法，有助于提高评估的可靠性和公平性。公开发布数据支持可重复性和进一步研究。

title: Train Short, Inference Long: Training-free Horizon Extension for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a scalable paradigm for long video generation. However, they often suffer from severe extrapolation failure, where rapid error accumulation leads to significant temporal degradation when extending beyond training horizons. We identify that this failure primarily stems from the spectral bias of 3D positional embeddings and the lack of dynamic priors in noise sampling. To address these issues, we propose FLEX (Frequency-aware Length EXtension), a training-free inference-time framework that bridges the gap between short-term training and long-term inference. FLEX introduces Frequency-aware RoPE Modulation to adaptively interpolate under-trained low-frequency components while extrapolating high-frequency ones to preserve multi-scale temporal discriminability. This is integrated with Antiphase Noise Sampling (ANS) to inject high-frequency dynamic priors and Inference-only Attention Sink to anchor global structure. Extensive evaluations on VBench demonstrate that FLEX significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models at 6x extrapolation (30s duration) and matches the performance of long-video fine-tuned baselines at 12x scale (60s duration). As a plug-and-play augmentation, FLEX seamlessly integrates into existing inference pipelines for horizon extension. It effectively pushes the generation limits of models such as LongLive, supporting consistent and dynamic video synthesis at a 4-minute scale. Project page is available at https://ga-lee.github.io/FLEX_demo.

AI.title_translation: 训练短，推理长：自回归视频生成的免训练时间范围扩展
AI.tldr: 提出FLEX，一种免训练推理框架，通过频率感知RoPE调制和反相位噪声采样解决自回归视频扩散模型在长期生成中的时序退化问题，实现大规模视频生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在扩展超出训练时间范围时，由于频谱偏置和噪声采样缺乏动态先验，导致严重的时序退化和错误累积。
AI.method: FLEX框架引入频率感知RoPE调制来适配插值低频成分并外推高频成分，结合反相位噪声采样注入动态先验，以及推理专用注意力锚点固定全局结构。
AI.result: 在VBench评估中，FLEX在6倍外推（30秒时长）显著优于最先进模型，在12倍规模（60秒时长）匹配长期微调基线性能，可支持4分钟规模的一致动态视频合成。
AI.conclusion: FLEX作为一种即插即用增强方法，能无缝集成现有推理流程，有效扩展视频生成极限，缓解训练与推理间的差距。
AI.translation: 自回归视频生成中的免训练时间范围扩展
AI.summary: FLEX框架针对自回归视频扩散模型长期生成中的时序退化问题，采用频率感知位置编码调制和动态噪声采样技术，实现免训练的大规模视频生成扩展，提升模型性能至多分钟级生成。
AI.keywords: 自回归视频生成, 扩散模型, 时间范围扩展, 频率感知调制, 噪声采样
AI.comments: 该方法聚焦推理优化，无需额外训练，具有实用性和可扩展性，但未提及计算开销或特定领域限制。

title: Annotation-Efficient Vision-Language Model Adaptation to the Polish Language Using the LLaVA Framework
summary: Most vision-language models (VLMs) are trained on English-centric data, limiting their performance in other languages and cultural contexts. This restricts their usability for non-English-speaking users and hinders the development of multimodal systems that reflect diverse linguistic and cultural realities. In this work, we reproduce and adapt the LLaVA-Next methodology to create a set of Polish VLMs. We rely on a fully automated pipeline for translating and filtering existing multimodal datasets, and complement this with synthetic Polish data for OCR and culturally specific tasks. Despite relying almost entirely on automatic translation and minimal manual intervention to the training data, our approach yields strong results: we observe a +9.5% improvement over LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B on a Polish-adapted MMBench, along with higher-quality captions in generative evaluations, as measured by human annotators in terms of linguistic correctness. These findings highlight that large-scale automated translation, combined with lightweight filtering, can effectively bootstrap high-quality multimodal models for low-resource languages. Some challenges remain, particularly in cultural coverage and evaluation. To facilitate further research, we make our models and evaluation dataset publicly available.

AI.title_translation: 使用 LLaVA 框架对波兰语进行标注高效的视觉-语言模型自适应
AI.tldr: 在几乎全自动翻译与轻量过滤的前提下，将 LLaVA-Next 适配到波兰语，显著提升波兰语多模态基准表现并公开模型与评测数据。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型大多基于以英语为中心的数据训练，在其他语言和文化环境下表现受限，削弱了其对非英语用户的实用性，也阻碍了多语言、多文化多模态系统的发展，因此需要一种低人工标注成本的方法将强大的 VLM 迁移到低资源语言（如波兰语）。
AI.method: 复现并改造 LLaVA-Next 方法，构建波兰语 VLM：通过全自动流水线将现有多模态数据集翻译成波兰语并做轻量过滤；再利用合成的波兰语数据增强 OCR 和文化特定任务；在几乎无人工标注干预的前提下完成训练和适配，并在波兰语改版 MMBench 和人工生成式评测上进行验证。
AI.result: 在波兰语改版 MMBench 上比 LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B 提升 9.5 个百分点，且在人类评测中生成的图像描述在语言正确性方面质量更高，证明自动大规模翻译与轻量过滤可以得到高质量的波兰语 VLM；同时构建并公开了模型和评测数据集。
AI.conclusion: 大规模自动翻译结合轻量数据过滤，在几乎不依赖人工标注的情况下也能有效启动并训练出高质量的低资源语言多模态模型，但在文化覆盖和评估方法上仍存在挑战，有待后续研究改进。
AI.translation: 大多数视觉-语言模型（VLM）是基于以英语为中心的数据进行训练的，这限制了它们在其他语言和文化语境中的表现。这既削弱了它们对非英语用户的可用性，也阻碍了能够反映多样语言和文化现实的多模态系统的发展。在本研究中，我们复现并改造 LLaVA-Next 方法，构建了一组波兰语 VLM。我们依赖一个全自动流水线来翻译和过滤现有多模态数据集，并辅以用于 OCR 和文化特定任务的合成波兰语数据。尽管训练数据几乎完全依赖自动翻译且只进行了最小限度的人工干预，我们的方法仍然取得了良好效果：在波兰语改版的 MMBench 上，我们相比 LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B 实现了 +9.5% 的提升，并且在人类标注者评估的生成式任务中，在语言正确性方面获得了更高质量的图像描述。这些发现表明，大规模自动翻译结合轻量过滤，可以有效地为低资源语言启动高质量的多模态模型。一些问题仍然存在，尤其是在文化覆盖和评估方面。为了促进进一步研究，我们将模型和评测数据集公开发布。
AI.summary: 论文针对现有 VLM 以英语为主、对波兰语等低资源语言支持不足的问题，复现并改造 LLaVA-Next 框架，构建了波兰语视觉-语言模型。作者设计了一个几乎全自动的多模态数据处理流水线：将现有多模态数据集自动翻译成波兰语并进行轻量过滤，同时生成专门面向 OCR 和文化特定任务的合成波兰语数据，以尽量减少人工标注和干预成本。在此基础上训练出的波兰语 LLaVA 模型，在波兰语改版 MMBench 上相对 LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B 提升 9.5 个百分点，并在人工评审的生成式图像描述任务中展现出更好的语言正确性。结果表明，利用大规模自动翻译加简单过滤即可有效启动和提升低资源语言多模态模型的质量，但在文化多样性覆盖和评估指标设计方面仍存在不足。作者将所构建的模型与评测数据集公开，以支持后续研究和应用拓展。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 多模态, LLaVA, 波兰语, 低资源语言, 自动翻译, 数据过滤, OCR, 文化特定任务, 基准评测
AI.comments: 工作重点在于验证“自动翻译 + 轻量过滤”在多模态低资源语言适配上的有效性，展示了较大的性能增益和可行的工程方案；不过摘要未给出具体数据规模、翻译与过滤策略细节以及在文化相关任务上的定量结果，这些是进一步评估方法通用性和可扩展性时需要关注的方面。

title: Flux-Balanced Patankar-type Schemes for the Compressible Euler Equations
summary: Positivity preservation of key physical quantities in the context of fluid flows, such as density and internal energy, is an essential property of a numerical scheme as otherwise the solution lacks physical relevance and has a not well-defined equation of state. One time integration technique that is capable of preserving the positivity of quantities for every time step size is the Patankar-trick and its variants. However, in the context of the Euler equations of gas dynamics, we wonder whether the Patankar-trick should be applied to the density and total energy equations or only to one of them. In this work, we discuss one drawback of the schemes when blindly applied to every positive conserved variable and additionally point out how to overcome the issue by balancing the involved numerical fluxes correctly. To illustrate our findings, we investigate modified Patankar--Runge--Kutta (MPRK) schemes in the context of the compressible Euler equations with and without stiff source terms. We discover that it is beneficial to only apply the Patankar-trick in the density equation and to balance the remaining numerical fluxes consistently rather than applying the trick also to the energy equation. This leads also to the preservation of contact discontinuities. We perform numerical experiments to demonstrate that the accuracy of the methods is maintained while the performance of our approach is superior to the traditional application of MPRK schemes.

AI.title_translation: 用于可压缩欧拉方程的通量平衡式帕坦卡型格式
AI.tldr: 提出了一种改进的帕坦卡型格式，仅将其应用于密度方程而非总能量方程，并通过通量平衡来克服原有方案的缺点，保持了准确性和接触间断的保持。
AI.motivation: 数值格式需保持流体流动中关键物理量（如密度和内能）的正性，否则解无物理意义且状态方程未定义。帕坦卡技巧及其变体能保持每步时间步长的正性，但应用于欧拉方程时，需探讨应将其用于密度和总能量方程还是仅其中之一。
AI.method: 讨论了将帕坦卡技巧盲目应用于每个正守恒变量时的缺点，提出通过正确平衡涉及的数值通量来克服该问题。在可压缩欧拉方程（含或不含刚性源项）背景下，研究了改进的帕坦卡-龙格-库塔（MPRK）格式。
AI.result: 发现仅将帕坦卡技巧应用于密度方程，并一致平衡剩余数值通量，优于也将其应用于能量方程的传统方法，这还保持了接触间断的保持。数值实验表明，该方法保持了准确性，且性能优于传统MPRK格式。
AI.conclusion: 建议在可压缩欧拉方程中仅将帕坦卡技巧应用于密度方程，并通过通量平衡来改进MPRK格式，以克服原有缺点并提升性能。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在可压缩欧拉方程中应用帕坦卡技巧时，应仅将其用于密度方程而非总能量方程，并通过通量平衡来避免盲目应用导致的缺点。研究使用MPRK格式进行实验，结果显示改进方法在保持准确性的同时，性能优于传统应用，并保持了接触间断。
AI.keywords: 帕坦卡技巧, 可压缩欧拉方程, 通量平衡, MPRK格式, 正性保持, 数值通量, 接触间断
AI.comments: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Query as Anchor: Scenario-Adaptive User Representation via Large Language Model
summary: Industrial-scale user representation learning requires balancing robust universality with acute task-sensitivity. However, existing paradigms primarily yield static, task-agnostic embeddings that struggle to reconcile the divergent requirements of downstream scenarios within unified vector spaces. Furthermore, heterogeneous multi-source data introduces inherent noise and modality conflicts, degrading representation. We propose Query-as-Anchor, a framework shifting user modeling from static encoding to dynamic, query-aware synthesis. To empower Large Language Models (LLMs) with deep user understanding, we first construct UserU, an industrial-scale pre-training dataset that aligns multi-modal behavioral sequences with user understanding semantics, and our Q-Anchor Embedding architecture integrates hierarchical coarse-to-fine encoders into dual-tower LLMs via joint contrastive-autoregressive optimization for query-aware user representation. To bridge the gap between general pre-training and specialized business logic, we further introduce Cluster-based Soft Prompt Tuning to enforce discriminative latent structures, effectively aligning model attention with scenario-specific modalities. For deployment, anchoring queries at sequence termini enables KV-cache-accelerated inference with negligible incremental latency. Evaluations on 10 Alipay industrial benchmarks show consistent SOTA performance, strong scalability, and efficient deployment. Large-scale online A/B testing in Alipay's production system across two real-world scenarios further validates its practical effectiveness. Our code is prepared for public release and will be available at: https://github.com/JhCircle/Q-Anchor.

AI.title_translation: 以查询为锚：面向场景自适应的大语言模型用户表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出“Query-as-Anchor”框架，用大模型和软提示将静态、任务无关的用户向量升级为面向具体查询和业务场景的动态用户表示，并在支付宝多项工业任务与线上实验中取得SOTA与显著业务收益。
AI.motivation: 工业级用户表示既需要在多任务间具有通用性，又要对具体业务场景高度敏感；然而现有方法大多生成静态、任务无关的向量，难以在统一表示空间中兼顾不同下游需求，同时多源异构行为数据存在噪声和模态冲突，进一步削弱表示质量。
AI.method: 1）提出“Query-as-Anchor”框架，将用户建模从静态编码转为基于查询的动态合成；2）构建大规模多模态用户预训练数据集UserU，使行为序列与用户理解语义对齐；3）设计Q-Anchor Embedding结构，在双塔LLM中引入层次化粗到细编码器，并通过对比学习+自回归联合优化获得对查询敏感的用户向量；4）提出基于聚类的软提示微调（Cluster-based Soft Prompt Tuning），在潜空间中构造可分判结构，使模型注意力对齐到特定业务场景相关模态；5）在部署端将查询锚定于序列末尾，利用KV-cache实现几乎无额外延迟的高效推理。
AI.result: 在支付宝10个工业级基准任务上取得持续的SOTA表现，并展示出较强的可扩展性和高效部署能力；在支付宝真实生产系统的两个业务场景中，大规模线上A/B测试验证了方法在实际业务指标上的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 动态、查询感知的LLM用户表示结合软提示场景适配，可以在多场景工业推荐/检索任务中同时实现更强的任务敏感性、通用性与部署效率，优于传统静态嵌入范式，并具备落地可行性。
AI.translation: 工业规模的用户表示学习需要在保持强鲁棒通用性的同时，又具备对具体任务的高敏感度。然而，现有范式主要产生静态、与任务无关的嵌入，在统一向量空间中难以协调不同下游场景的差异化需求。此外，异构多源数据带来的固有噪声和模态冲突会削弱表示质量。为此，我们提出“Query-as-Anchor”框架，将用户建模从静态编码转变为基于查询的动态、查询感知合成。为赋予大语言模型对用户的深度理解，我们首先构建工业级预训练数据集UserU，使多模态行为序列与用户理解语义对齐；同时提出Q-Anchor Embedding架构，将层次化的粗到细编码器集成进双塔LLM中，并通过对比学习与自回归联合优化，得到对查询敏感的用户表示。为弥合通用预训练与特定业务逻辑之间的鸿沟，我们进一步引入基于聚类的软提示微调（Cluster-based Soft Prompt Tuning），以强化潜在空间中的可分判结构，有效地将模型注意力对齐到场景相关模态。部署时，将查询锚定在序列末端，可借助KV-cache加速推理，几乎不增加额外时延。在支付宝10个工业基准上的评测表明，本方法在性能上持续达到最新水平，具有良好的可扩展性和高效部署能力。在支付宝生产系统两个真实业务场景中的大规模线上A/B测试进一步验证了其实际有效性。我们的代码已准备好对外开源，并将发布于：https://github.com/JhCircle/Q-Anchor。
AI.summary: 本文面向工业级推荐/检索等多场景任务，提出“Query-as-Anchor”用户建模框架，将用户表示从单一静态向量改造为依赖查询、可随场景动态合成的表示。作者构建多模态用户行为与语义对齐的预训练数据集UserU，并在双塔LLM中嵌入层次化编码器，通过对比+自回归联合训练获得高质量用户与查询向量。为适配具体业务逻辑，引入基于聚类的软提示微调，在潜空间中形成清晰聚类结构，引导模型聚焦场景相关模态。通过将查询置于序列末尾并结合KV缓存，实现几乎无额外延迟的在线推理。实验在支付宝10个工业基准上取得SOTA，在两个真实业务场景的线上A/B实验中也带来显著收益，显示出该框架的实用价值与可部署性。
AI.keywords: 用户表示学习, 大语言模型, Query-as-Anchor, 多模态行为序列, 对比学习, 自回归建模, 软提示微调, 工业推荐系统
AI.comments: 方法结合工业级数据与LLM，设计较为系统，但摘要未说明与非LLM大规模序列模型（如专门的序列推荐Transformer）的对比细节，也未披露具体指标提升幅度、计算成本和参数规模；UserU和模型在支付宝场景下构建，泛化到其他平台与数据分布尚需进一步验证。隐私保护与数据合规处理方式在摘要中也未提及。

title: An Empirical Study of the Evolution of GitHub Actions Workflows
comments: 40 pages. Preprint of manuscript accepted in the Elsevier Journal of Systems and Software. Exact publication details will be provided upon official publication
summary: CI/CD practices play a significant role during collaborative software development by automating time-consuming and repetitive tasks such as testing, building, quality checking, dependency and security management. GitHub Actions, the CI/CD tool integrated into GitHub, allows repository maintainers to automate development workflows. We conducted a mixed methods analysis of GitHub Actions workflow changes over time. Through a preliminary qualitative analysis of 439 modified workflow files we identified seven types of conceptual changes to workflows. Next, we performed a quantitative analysis over 49K+ GitHub repositories totaling 267K+ workflow change histories and 3.4M+ workflow file versions from November 2019 to August 2025. This analysis revealed that repositories contain a median of three workflow files, and 7.3% of all workflow files are being changed every week. The changes made to workflows tend to be small, with about three-quarters containing only a single change. The large majority of the observed changes have to do with task configuration and task specification in workflow jobs. We did not find any conclusive evidence of the effect of LLM coding tools or other major technological changes on workflow creation and workflow maintenance frequency. Our findings highlight the need for improved tooling to support fine-grained maintenance tasks, such as a broader adoption of dependency management and AI-based support for ensuring and sustaining workflow security and quality.
